title.zh: 卷九 本紀第九: 玄宗下
title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九: 玄宗下 Volume 9 Annals 9: Xuanzong 2

sentences.zh: 開元二十五年春正月壬午，制：「朕猥集休運，多謝哲王，然而哀矜之情，小大必慎。

translations.literal: In Kaiyuan 25, first spring month, on renwu, an edict: "I have undeservedly gathered the fortune of peace and owe much to the sage kings; yet my compassion for suffering, great and small, must ever be careful.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kaiyuan 25, on renwu, the emperor issued an edict: "Fortune has favored me beyond merit, and I stand in debt to the sage kings of old; yet pity for the suffering—great and small—must govern every judgment."

sentences.zh: 自臨寰宇，子育黎烝，未嘗行極刑，起大獄。

translations.literal: Since I ascended to rule the realm and nourish the people, I have never imposed extreme punishments or launched great persecutions.
translations.idiomatic: Since taking the throne to nurture the realm, I have never imposed extreme punishments or opened great persecutions.

sentences.zh: 上玄降鑒，應以祥和，思協平邦之典，致之仁壽之域。

translations.literal: Heaven above has sent down its mirror; the response should be harmony and auspice. I wish to harmonize the norms of a tranquil state and bring the people into the domain of benevolence and longevity.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has shown its sign; the answer must be harmony. I mean to align the state with tranquil rule and lead the people toward benevolence and long life.

sentences.zh: 自今有犯死刑，除十惡罪，宜令中書門下與法官詳所犯輕重，具狀奏聞。

translations.literal: From now on, when anyone is guilty of death, except for the Ten Abominations, the Secretariat-Chancellery and the judges shall together weigh the gravity of the offense, prepare a full report, and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all capital cases, save the Ten Abominations, shall be reviewed by the Secretariat-Chancellery and the judges, who must weigh the offense and memorialize with a full report.

sentences.zh: 崇德尚齒，三代丕義；

translations.literal: Honoring virtue and respecting age were the great righteousness of the Three Dynasties;
translations.idiomatic: To honor virtue and respect age was the great righteousness of the Three Dynasties;

sentences.zh: 敦風勸俗，五教攸先。

translations.literal: to strengthen custom and encourage folkways, the Five Teachings come first.
translations.idiomatic: to strengthen custom and guide the people, the Five Teachings come first.

sentences.zh: 其曾任五品已上清資官以禮去職者，所司具錄名奏，老疾不堪厘務者與致仕。

translations.literal: Those who once held fifth rank or higher as pure-capital officials and left office by ritual propriety—the relevant offices shall compile their names and memorialize; those aged or ill and unable to manage affairs shall be granted retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Former pure-capital officials of fifth rank or above who left office with propriety shall be listed and reported; those aged or ill and unfit for duty shall receive retirement.

sentences.zh: 道士、女冠宜隸宗正寺，僧尼令祠部檢校。

translations.literal: Daoist priests and female Daoists should be placed under the Court of the Imperial Clan; Buddhist monks and nuns shall be inspected by the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Daoist priests and nuns shall fall under the Court of the Imperial Clan; Buddhist monks and nuns shall be overseen by the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 百司每旬節休假，並不須入曹司，任游勝為樂。

translations.literal: On each ten-day festival holiday all offices need not enter their bureaus; officials may seek scenic pleasure as they wish.
translations.idiomatic: On the ten-day festival holidays no office need keep bureau hours; officials may seek their pleasure where they will.

sentences.zh: 宣示中外，知朕意焉。

translations.literal: Let this be proclaimed within and without, that all may know my intent."
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed at court and in the provinces, that all may know my mind."

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，道士尹愔為諫議大夫、集賢學士兼知史館事。

translations.literal: " On guimao the Daoist Yin Yin became Remonstrance Grandee, Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and concurrent director of the History Office.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Daoist Yin Yin was made remonstrance grandee, academy scholar, and concurrent director of the History Office.

sentences.zh: 二月，新羅王金興光卒，其子承慶嗣位，遣贊善大夫邢璹攝鴻臚少卿，往吊祭，冊立之。

translations.literal: In the second month King Hingwang of Silla died; his son Seonggyeong succeeded. The court sent Goodwill Commissioner Xing Shuo acting as vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments to mourn, perform sacrifices, and invest the new king.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month King Hingwang of Silla died and his son Seonggyeong succeeded. Xing Shuo, goodwill commissioner acting as vice director of imperial entertainments, was sent to mourn, sacrifice, and invest him.

sentences.zh: 壬子，加宗正丞一員。

translations.literal: On renzi one additional vice director of the Court of the Imperial Clan was added.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Court of the Imperial Clan gained one vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷江淮運，停河北運。

translations.literal: On wuwu transport on the Jiang-Huai circuit was abolished and transport on the Hebei circuit suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Jiang-Huai transport was abolished and Hebei transport suspended.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，張守珪破契丹餘眾於㮈祿山，殺獲甚眾。

translations.literal: On guiyou Zhang Shougui crushed the remaining Khitan at Mount Zelu, killing and capturing a great host.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zhang Shougui routed the remaining Khitan at Mount Zelu with heavy slaughter.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，河西節度使崔希逸自涼州南率眾入吐蕃界二千餘里。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yimao, Hexi military commissioner Cui Xiyi led troops south from Liang Prefecture more than two thousand li into Tibetan territory.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the third month Hexi commissioner Cui Xiyi marched south from Liang Prefecture more than two thousand li into Tibetan lands.

sentences.zh: 己亥，希逸至青海西郎佐素文子觜，與賊相遇，大破之，斬首二千餘級。

translations.literal: On jihai Xiyi reached Langzuo Suwenzi Mouth west of Qinghai Lake, met the enemy, and routed them, beheading more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Xiyi reached Langzuo Suwenzi Mouth west of Qinghai Lake, met the enemy, and took more than two thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，陳、許、豫、壽四州開稻田。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on gengxu, Chen, Xu, Yu, and Shou prefectures opened paddy fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Chen, Xu, Yu, and Shou opened new paddy fields.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，監察御史周子諒上書忤旨，㩧之殿庭，朝堂決杖死之。

translations.literal: On xinyou Supervising Censor Zhou Ziliang memorialized in offense to the throne; he was dragged through the palace court and beaten to death with the court staff.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou censor Zhou Ziliang offended the throne in a memorial; he was dragged through the palace court and beaten to death with the court staff.

sentences.zh: 甲子，尚書右丞相張九齡以曾薦引子諒，左授荊州長史。

translations.literal: On jiazi Right Secretariat Director Zhang Jiuling, for having once recommended Ziliang, was demoted to prefect of Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhang Jiuling, right secretariat director, was demoted to Jing prefect for having once recommended Ziliang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇太子瑛、鄂王瑤、光王琚並廢為庶人。

translations.literal: On yichou Crown Prince Ying, Prince of E Yao, and Prince of Guang Ju were all deposed as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Crown Prince Ying and Princes Yao of E and Ju of Guang were deposed as commoners.

sentences.zh: 太子妃兄駙馬都尉薛鏽長流瀼州，至藍田驛賜死。

translations.literal: The crown prince's brother-in-law, Commandant of Horse Xue Chuo, was exiled in long transport to Rang Prefecture and, at Lantian post station, ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's brother-in-law Xue Chuo, commandant of horse, was exiled toward Rang and ordered to die at Lantian post.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，熒惑犯房，至心星越度而過。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renxu, Mars invaded the Room mansion, crossed the Heart star, and passed beyond.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Mars invaded the Room mansion, crossed the Heart star, and passed on.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，大理少卿徐岵奏：「天下今歲斷死刑五十八，幾致刑措，鳥巢寺之獄。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on jimao, Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xu Kun memorialized: "Under Heaven this year fifty-eight death sentences were pronounced—nearly attaining the era when punishments need not be used—the case of Bird Nest Temple."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xu Kun, vice director of judicial review, reported that the realm had seen only fifty-eight executions this year—nearly the age when punishments fall unused—and cited the Bird Nest Temple case.

sentences.zh: 」上特推功元輔，庚辰，封李林甫為晉國公，牛仙客為豳國公。

translations.literal: " The emperor specially attributed the merit to his chief ministers; on gengchen Li Linfu was enfeoffed Duke of Jin and Niu Xianke Duke of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor credited his chief ministers; on gengchen Li Linfu became Duke of Jin and Niu Xianke Duke of Bin.

sentences.zh: 己卯，敕諸陵廟並隸宗正寺，其宗正寺官員，自今並以宗枝為之。

translations.literal: On jimao an edict placed all imperial tombs and temples under the Court of the Imperial Clan; from now its officials shall all be drawn from the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict placed all imperial tombs and temples under the Court of the Imperial Clan, whose officers would hereafter be clan members.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，頒新定《令》、《式》、《格》及《事類》一百三十卷於天下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen, the newly revised Statutes, Regulations, Codes, and Categories in one hundred thirty juan were promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the newly revised statutes, regulations, codes, and categories—one hundred thirty juan—were promulgated empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，制自今年每年立春日迎春於東郊，其夏及秋冬如常。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month an edict ordered that from this year each spring, on the day the year begins, the court welcome spring at the eastern suburb; summer, autumn, and winter would follow custom.
translations.idiomatic: That winter an edict ordered annual spring rites at the eastern suburb on New Year's day; summer, autumn, and winter would follow custom.

sentences.zh: 以十二月朔日於正殿受朝，讀時令。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month the emperor received court at the main hall and had the seasonal ordinances read.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month's first day he received court at the main hall and had the seasonal ordinances read.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renshen, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he visited the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，開府儀同三司、廣平郡公宋璟薨。

translations.literal: On dingchou Grand Preceptor of Honor, Duke of Guangping Song Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Song Jing, grand preceptor of honor and Duke of Guangping, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，惠妃武氏薨，追謚為貞順皇后，葬於敬陵。

translations.literal: On bingwu Consort Wu died; she was posthumously styled Empress Zhenshun and buried at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Consort Wu died, was posthumously styled Empress Zhenshun, and was buried at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃使其大臣屬盧論莽藏來朝貢。

translations.literal: Tibet sent its minister Shulun Mangzang to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet sent Minister Shulun Mangzang with tribute.

sentences.zh: 開元二十六年春正月乙亥，工部尚書牛仙客為侍中。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan 26, first spring month, on yihai, Minister of Works Niu Xianke became Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kaiyuan 26, on yihai, Niu Xianke, minister of works, became palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，親迎氣於東郊，祀青帝。

translations.literal: On dingchou he personally welcomed the qi at the eastern suburb and sacrificed to the Green Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he welcomed the qi at the eastern suburb and sacrificed to the Green Emperor.

sentences.zh: 制天下系囚，死罪流嶺南，餘並放免。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that prisoners under death sentence be exiled to Lingnan and all others released.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exiled death-row prisoners to Lingnan and released the rest.

sentences.zh: 鎮兵部還。

translations.literal: Garrison troops returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops were sent home.

sentences.zh: 京兆府新開稻田，並散給貧人。

translations.literal: New paddy fields opened in the metropolitan prefecture were distributed to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: New metropolitan paddy was distributed to the poor.

sentences.zh: 百官賜勛絹。

translations.literal: The hundred officials were granted merit silk.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials received merit silk.

sentences.zh: 長安、萬年兩縣各與本錢一千貫，收利供馹，仍付雜馹。

translations.literal: Chang'an and Wannian counties each received one thousand strings of cash principal to collect interest for post-horses, still assigned to miscellaneous courier duty.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an and Wannian each received a thousand strings of principal to fund post-horses by interest, still assigned to courier duty.

sentences.zh: 天下州縣，每鄉一學，仍擇師資，令其教授。

translations.literal: Every district in the realm was to have one school per township, with teachers chosen to instruct.
translations.idiomatic: Every township in the realm was to have a school with appointed teachers.

sentences.zh: 諸鄉貢每年令就國子監謁先師，明經加口試。

translations.literal: Each year local candidates were to visit the Directorate of Education to pay respects to the former master; candidates in the Classics Examination received an oral test.
translations.idiomatic: Each year local candidates were to visit the directorate to honor the former master; classics candidates faced an oral examination.

sentences.zh: 內外八品已下及草澤有博學文辭之士，各委本司本州聞薦。

translations.literal: Those below eighth rank inside and outside the court, and commoners of broad learning and literary excellence, were to be recommended by their offices and prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Officials below eighth rank and learned commoners were to be recommended by their offices and prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，以李林甫遙領隴右節度使。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinmao, Li Linfu was made concurrent Longyou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Li Linfu became concurrent Longyou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，禁大寒食以雞卵相饋送。

translations.literal: On jiachen the Great Cold Food Festival gift of eggs was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen exchanging eggs at the Great Cold Food Festival was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 庚申，葬貞順皇后於敬陵。

translations.literal: On gengshen Empress Zhenshun was buried at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court buried Empress Zhenshun at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以牛仙客遙領河東道節度使。

translations.literal: On yimao Niu Xianke was made concurrent Hedong circuit military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Niu Xianke became concurrent Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，廢仙州，分其屬縣隸許、汝等州。

translations.literal: On xinyou Xian Prefecture was abolished; its counties were attached to Xu, Ru, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Xian Prefecture was abolished and its counties reassigned.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳朔，減秘書省校書、正字官員。

translations.literal: On the third month, jisi new moon, proofreaders and rectifiers of the Secretariat were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's new moon secretariat proofreaders and rectifiers were reduced.

sentences.zh: 丙子，有星孛於紫微垣中，歷斗魁十餘日，因陰雲不見。

translations.literal: On bingzi a comet appeared within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, traversing the Dipper for more than ten days; clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a comet crossed the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and the Dipper for ten days before clouds hid it.

sentences.zh: 己酉，河南、洛陽兩縣亦借本錢一千貫，收利充人吏課役。

translations.literal: On jiyou Henan and Luoyang counties also borrowed a thousand strings of principal, interest to cover clerks' corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Henan and Luoyang borrowed a thousand strings each to fund clerks' corvée by interest.

sentences.zh: 癸未，京兆地震。

translations.literal: On guiwei the metropolitan prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the capital region shook.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇河西，左散騎常侍崔希逸擊破之；

translations.literal: Tibet raided Hexi; Left Regular Attendant Cui Xiyi defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Hexi and Cui Xiyi, left regular attendant, drove them off;

sentences.zh: 鄯州都督杜希望又攻拔新羅城，制以其城為威戎軍。

translations.literal: Zongzhou prefect Du Xiwang also stormed and took Xinluo city; an edict made that place Weirong Army.
translations.idiomatic: Zong prefect Du Xiwang stormed Xinluo city, which was made Weirong Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥朔，始令太常卿韋絳讀時令於宣政殿，百僚於殿上列坐而聽之。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on jihai new moon, the Grand Minister of Sacrifices Wei Jiang first read the seasonal ordinances in the Xuanzheng Hall while the hundred officials sat in ranks on the hall to listen.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth month's new moon Wei Jiang first read the seasonal ordinances in the Xuanzheng Hall as officials sat ranked to listen.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，以李林甫遙領河西節度使，兼判梁州事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou, Li Linfu was made concurrent Hexi military commissioner and also judged Liang Prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Li Linfu became concurrent Hexi commissioner and judged Liang affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸咸宜公主宅。

translations.literal: On gengyin he visited Princess Xianyi's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he visited Princess Xianyi.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，立忠王璵為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengzi, Prince Zhong Yu was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Prince Zhong Yu was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，冊皇太子，大赦天下，常赦所不免者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on jisi, the crown prince was invested; a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and even those normally excluded were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the crown prince was invested; the realm was amnestied, even those usually excluded.

sentences.zh: 內外文武官及五品已上為父後者各賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside the court, and those of fifth rank and above who were heirs to fathers, each received one turn of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of fifth rank and above who were heirs each gained one merit turn.

sentences.zh: 忠王府官及侍講加一階。

translations.literal: Crown prince household officers and lecturers each gained one rank.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's household officers and lecturers each gained one rank.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Feasting was granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: The court feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，分越州置明州。

translations.literal: On gengchen Yue Prefecture was split to establish Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Ming Prefecture was carved from Yue.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the sun was eclipsed on the new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚子，於舊六胡州地置宥州。

translations.literal: On gengzi You Prefecture was established on the old territory of the Six Hu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi You Prefecture was established on the old Six Hu lands.

sentences.zh: 益州長史王昱率兵攻吐蕃安戎城，為賊所據，官軍大敗，昱棄甲而遁，兵士死者數千人。

translations.literal: Yizhou prefect Wang Yu led troops to storm the Tibetan fortress of Anrong; the enemy held it, the army was utterly defeated, Yu cast off his armor and fled, and several thousand soldiers died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yu of Yizhou stormed Tibetan Anrong, was routed, fled without armor, and lost thousands.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he visited the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲渤海靺鞨王大武藝死，其子欽茂嗣立，遣使吊祭，冊立之。

translations.literal: That year King Muye of Parhae died; his son Chinmok succeeded. Envoys were sent to mourn and invest him.
translations.idiomatic: That year King Muye of Parhae died; envoys mourned and invested his son Chinmok.

sentences.zh: 其冬，兩京建行宮，造殿宇各千餘間。

translations.literal: That winter traveling palaces were built in the two capitals, with more than a thousand chambers each.
translations.idiomatic: That winter traveling palaces rose in both capitals, a thousand chambers apiece.

sentences.zh: 潤州刺史齊浣開伊婁河於揚州南瓜洲浦。

translations.literal: Run Prefecture prefect Qi Huan opened the Yilou River at Nanguazhou Ford in Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Huan of Runzhou opened the Yilou River at Nanguazhou ford.

sentences.zh: 析左右羽林軍置左右龍武軍，以左右萬騎營隸焉。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Forest Armies were split to form the Left and Right Dragon Martial Armies, with the Left and Right Ten Thousand Riders camps placed under them.
translations.idiomatic: The Forest Armies were split into Left and Right Dragon Martial Armies subordinating the Ten Thousand Riders camps.

sentences.zh: 開元二十七年春正月乙巳，大雨雪。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan 27, first spring month, on yisi, heavy rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kaiyuan 27 heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，加尊號開元聖文神武皇帝，大赦天下，常赦所不免者咸赦除之，開元已來諸色痕瘕人咸從洗滌，左降官量移近處。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jisi, the honorific Kaiyuan Sage Literary Divine Martial Emperor was added; a great amnesty was proclaimed, even those normally excluded were pardoned, all branded persons since Kaiyuan were washed clean, and demoted officials were moved nearer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the emperor took the added title Kaiyuan Sage Literary Divine Martial Emperor, amnestied the realm including the usually excluded, cleared Kaiyuan-era brands, and moved demoted officials nearer.

sentences.zh: 百姓免今年租稅。

translations.literal: The people were exempted from this year's land tax and levies.
translations.idiomatic: This year's taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 三品已上賜爵一級，四品已上加一階。

translations.literal: Those of third rank and above received one noble rank; fourth rank and below one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank and above gained a noble rank; fourth and below one grade.

sentences.zh: 宗廟薦饗，自今已後並用宗子。

translations.literal: For imperial temple offerings, from now on imperial sons would be used.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial temple offerings would hereafter use imperial sons.

sentences.zh: 賜酺五日。

translations.literal: Feasting was granted for five days.
translations.idiomatic: Feasting lasted five days.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，廢洮州隸蘭州，改臨州為洮州。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on dingchou, Tao Prefecture was abolished and attached to Lan; Lin Prefecture was renamed Tao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Tao was attached to Lan and Lin renamed Tao.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太子少傅竇𤥟為開府儀同三司，吏部尚書李暠為太子少傅。

translations.literal: On yiyou Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Dou Dan became Grand Preceptor of Honor; Minister of Personnel Li Hao became heir apparent junior tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Dou Dan became grand preceptor of honor and Li Hao heir apparent junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，侍中牛仙客為兵部尚書兼侍中；

translations.literal: On dingyou Palace Attendant Niu Xianke became Minister of War and still Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Niu Xianke became minister of war while remaining palace attendant;

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書兼中書令李林甫為吏部尚書，依舊兼中書令。

translations.literal: Minister of War and concurrent Secretariat Director Li Linfu became Minister of Personnel, still concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Li Linfu became minister of personnel while remaining secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 以東宮內侍隸內侍省為署。

translations.literal: Eastern Palace inner attendants were placed under the Directorate of Palace Attendants as a bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Palace inner attendants were placed under the palace directorate.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，置龍武軍官員。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guimao, Dragon Martial Army posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Dragon Martial Army posts were established.

sentences.zh: 先是，鄎國公主之子薛諗與其黨李談、崔洽、石如山同於京城殺人，或利其財，或違其志，即白日椎殺，煮而食之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Princess Zheng's son Xue Shen and his gang Li Tan, Cui Qia, and Shi Ruyan had murdered people in the capital—sometimes for wealth, sometimes when crossed—and in broad daylight would bludgeon victims, boil, and eat them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Princess Zheng's son Xue Shen and accomplices Li Tan, Cui Qia, and Shi Ruyan had murdered in the capital by day, sometimes boiling the dead.

sentences.zh: 其夏事發，皆決殺於京兆府門，諗以國親流瀼州，賜死於城東驛。

translations.literal: When the affair broke that summer, all were executed at the metropolitan government gate; Shen, as imperial kin, was exiled in transport to Rang and ordered to die at the eastern post station.
translations.idiomatic: When the plot broke they were executed at the capital gate; Shen, as kin, was exiled and ordered to die at the eastern post.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，內常侍牛仙童坐贓，決殺之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Inner Regular Attendant Niu Xiantong was executed for bribery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Niu Xiantong, inner regular attendant, was executed for bribery.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使、兼御史大夫張守珪以賄貶為括州刺史。

translations.literal: Youzhou military commissioner and concurrent censor-in-chief Zhang Shougui was demoted to prefect of Kuo for bribery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shougui, Youzhou commissioner, was demoted to Kuo prefect for bribery.

sentences.zh: 太子太師、徐國公蕭嵩以嘗賂仙童，左授青州刺史。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Grand Tutor and Duke of Xu Xiao Song, for having once bribed Xiantong, was demoted to prefect of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Song, heir apparent grand tutor and Duke of Xu, was demoted to Qing prefect for bribing Xiantong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on xinchou, Mars invaded the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Mars invaded the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 北庭都護蓋嘉運以輕騎襲破突騎施於碎葉城，殺蘇祿，威震西陲。

translations.literal: Beiting protector-general Gai Jiayun with light cavalry raided and crushed the Turgesh at Suyab, killed Suolu, and his prestige shook the western marches.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Jiayun of Beiting raided the Turgesh at Suyab, killed Suolu, and shook the west.

sentences.zh: 八月，吐蕃寇白草、安人等。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Tibet raided Baicao, Anren, and other posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Tibet raided Baicao and Anren.

sentences.zh: 甲申，制追贈孔宣父為文宣王，顏回為兗國公，餘十哲皆為侯，夾坐。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict posthumously enfeoffed Confucius as King Wenxuan; Yan Hui as Duke of Yan; the other Ten Sages as marquises, seated on either side.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Confucius was posthumously styled King Wenxuan, Yan Hui Duke of Yan, and the Ten Sages marquises flanking him.

sentences.zh: 後嗣褒聖侯改封為文宣公。

translations.literal: The heir of the enfeoffed Sage was changed to Duke Wenxuan.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius's enfeoffed heir was restyled Duke Wenxuan.

sentences.zh: 九月，皇太子改名紹。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the crown prince changed his name to Shao.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the crown prince took the name Shao.

sentences.zh: 汴州刺史齊浣請開汴河下流，自虹縣至淮陰北合於淮，逾時而功畢。

translations.literal: Bian Prefecture prefect Qi Huan requested opening the lower Bian River from Hong County to north of Huaiyin to join the Huai; in time the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Huan of Bian opened the lower Bian from Hong to Huaiyin; the work finished on schedule.

sentences.zh: 因棄沙壅舊路，行者弊之，尋而新河之水勢淙急，遂填塞矣。

translations.literal: The old course, choked by silt, wearied travelers; soon the new channel ran swift and silted shut again.
translations.idiomatic: The old silt-choked route wearied travelers; soon the swift new channel silted shut.

sentences.zh: 前刑部尚書致仕崔隱甫卒。

translations.literal: Former Minister of Punishments in retirement Cui Yinpu died.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yinpu, retired minister of punishments, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，將改作明堂。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month the Bright Hall was to be rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Bright Hall was to be rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 偽言官取小兒埋於明堂之下，以為厭勝。

translations.literal: False reports said officials were taking children to bury beneath the Bright Hall for apotropaic magic.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors spread that officials buried children under the Bright Hall for apotropaic magic.

sentences.zh: 村野童兒藏於山谷，都城騷然，咸言兵至。

translations.literal: Country children hid in valleys; the capital was alarmed, all saying troops were coming.
translations.idiomatic: Children hid in the hills; the capital panicked, crying that soldiers were coming.

sentences.zh: 上惡之，遣主客郎中王佶往東都及諸州宣慰百姓，久之定。

translations.literal: The emperor detested this; Chief of Guest Affairs Wang Ji was sent to the eastern capital and the provinces to reassure the people; after long delay it subsided.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor loathed the panic and sent Wang Ji to reassure the eastern capital and the provinces until calm returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，毀東都明堂之上層，改拆下層為乾元殿。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month the upper story of the eastern capital Bright Hall was torn down; the lower story was rebuilt as Qianyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Bright Hall's upper story was torn down and the lower rebuilt as Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On wuxu he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On xinchou he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 十二月，東都副留守、太子賓客崔沔卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Eastern Capital deputy guardian and heir apparent guest of honor Cui Yong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Cui Yong, eastern capital deputy guardian and heir apparent guest, died.

sentences.zh: 以益州司馬章仇兼瓊權劍南節度等使。

translations.literal: Yizhou army adjutant Zhang Qiu Jianqiong was made acting Jiannan and other circuits military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiu Jianqiong was made acting Jiannan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蓋嘉運大破突騎施之眾，擒其王吐火仙，送於京師。

translations.literal: That year Gai Jiayun crushed the Turgesh host, captured their king Tuhuoxian, and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gai Jiayun crushed the Turgesh, captured King Tuhuoxian, and sent him to court.

sentences.zh: 開元二十八年春正月，兩京路及城中苑內種果樹。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan 28, first spring month, fruit trees were planted along the roads of the two capitals and in palace gardens.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kaiyuan 28 fruit trees were planted along both capitals' roads and in palace gardens.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On guisi he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he went to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On gengzi he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以望日御勤政樓宴群臣，連夜燒燈，會大雪而罷，因命自今常以二月望日夜為之。

translations.literal: On renyin, on the full moon, he held a banquet for ministers at the Diligence-in-Government Tower; lamps burned through the night until heavy snow ended it; henceforth the second month's full-moon night was made permanent.
translations.idiomatic: On the full moon he banqueted ministers at the Diligence-in-Government Tower until snow ended the lamp-night; thereafter the second month's full moon became a fixed feast.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dinghai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，權判益州長史章仇兼瓊拔吐蕃安戎城，分兵鎮守之。

translations.literal: On renzi Acting Yizhou prefect Zhang Qiu Jianqiong stormed Tibetan Anrong fortress and garrisoned troops there.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Jianqiong stormed Tibetan Anrong and left garrisons.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，太子少師韓休、太子少傅李暠卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth summer month Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Han Xiu and Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Li Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month Han Xiu and Li Hao, heir apparent junior tutors, died.

sentences.zh: 六月，懷州刺史、信安王禕為太子少師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Huai Prefecture prefect, Prince Xin'an Yi, became heir apparent junior tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Prince Xin'an Yi of Huai became heir apparent junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太子賓客李尚隱卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin Heir Apparent Guest of Honor Li Shangyin died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Shangyin, heir apparent guest, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，追尊宣皇帝陵名曰建初，光皇帝陵名曰啟運，仍置官員。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on renyin, the tombs of the Proclaimed and Luminous emperors were named Jianchu and Qiyun, with officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Proclaimed Emperor's tomb was named Jianchu and the Luminous Emperor's Qiyun, with officers appointed.

sentences.zh: 九月，魏州刺史盧暉開通濟渠，自石灰窠引流至州城而西，卻注魏橋。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Wei Prefecture prefect Lu Hui opened the Tongji Canal from Shihui Nest to the prefectural city and west to pour back at Wei Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Lu Hui of Wei opened the Tongji Canal from Shihui Nest to the city and back to Wei Bridge.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，封皇孫俶等十九人為郡王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengyin, nineteen imperial grandsons including Shu were enfeoffed as princes of commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin nineteen imperial grandsons including Shu were enfeoffed as commandery princes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on jiazi, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he visited the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On xinsi he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉夜，東都新殿後佛光寺災。

translations.literal: On yiyou night the Buddhist Guangji Temple behind the eastern capital's new hall burned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou night Guangji Temple behind the new eastern hall burned.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇安戎城。

translations.literal: Tibet raided Anrong fortress.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Anrong.

sentences.zh: 十一月，牛仙客停遙兼朔方、河東節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Niu Xianke ceased his concurrent Shuofang and Hedong military commissions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Niu Xianke left his Shuofang and Hedong commissions.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，突騎施酋長莫賀達干率眾內屬。

translations.literal: On yimao Turgesh chieftain Mohedagan led his band to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Turgesh chief Mohedagan submitted with his people.

sentences.zh: 己未，禮部尚書杜暹卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei Minister of Rites Du Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Du Xian, minister of rites, died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，金城公主薨，吐蕃遣使來告喪。

translations.literal: That year Princess Jincheng died; Tibet sent envoys to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: That year Princess Jincheng died and Tibet announced mourning.

sentences.zh: 其時頻歲豐稔，京師米斛不滿二百，天下乂安，雖行萬里不持兵刃。

translations.literal: Years of abundance followed; rice in the capital did not reach two hundred per hu; peace held so that one might travel ten thousand li without bearing arms.
translations.idiomatic: Harvests ran rich; capital rice fell below two hundred cash per hu; peace held so one could travel ten thousand li unarmed.

sentences.zh: 開元二十九年春正月丁丑，制兩京、諸州各置玄元皇帝廟並崇玄學，置生徒，令習《老子》、《莊子》、《列子》、《文子》，每年準明經例考試。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan 29, first spring month, on dingchou, an edict ordered Xuan Yuan Emperor temples and Chongxuan schools in the two capitals and all prefectures, with students studying Laozi, Zhuangzi, Liezi, and Wenzi, examined yearly by the Classics Examination standard.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kaiyuan 29 an edict ordered Xuan Yuan temples and Chongxuan schools in both capitals and every prefecture, with students examined yearly on Laozi, Zhuangzi, Liezi, and Wenzi.

sentences.zh: 內外官有伯叔兄弟子侄堪任刺史、縣令，所司親自保薦。

translations.literal: Inside and outside the court, uncles, brothers, sons, and nephews fit for prefect or magistrate were to be personally recommended by their offices.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were to personally recommend kin fit for prefect or magistrate.

sentences.zh: 禁九品已下清資官置客舍邸店車坊、士庶厚葬。

translations.literal: Pure-capital officials below ninth rank were forbidden guesthouses, relay lodges, and carriage shops; the gentry and commoners were forbidden lavish burial.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth-rank pure officials were barred from inn and carriage shops; lavish burial was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 三月，吐蕃、突厥各遣使來朝。

translations.literal: In the third month Tibet and the Turks each sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Tibet and the Turks each sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙午，風霾，日色無影。

translations.literal: On bingwu wind and dust rose; the sun cast no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu dust storms hid the sun's shadow.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌朔。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on gengxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth summer month opened on gengxu new moon.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以太原裴伷先為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On bingchen Taiyuan Pei Xianxian became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Pei Xianxian of Taiyuan became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 韋虛心卒。

translations.literal: Wei Xuxin died.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xuxin, vice director of the secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 親王已下及內外官各賜錢令宴樂。

translations.literal: Imperial princes and inside and outside officials were each granted cash for feasting.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and officials received cash for feasts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以左右金吾大將軍裴寬為太原尹、北都留守。

translations.literal: On renwu Left and Right Golden Guard grand generals Pei Kuan became Taiyuan prefect and northern capital guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Pei Kuan became Taiyuan prefect and northern capital guardian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，洛水泛漲，毀天津橋及上陽宮仗舍。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on yimao, the Luo River flooded, destroying Tianjin Bridge and the Shangyang Palace guard quarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Luo flooded, destroying Tianjin Bridge and Shangyang guard quarters.

sentences.zh: 洛、渭之間，廬舍壞，溺死者千餘人。

translations.literal: Between Luo and Wei, houses collapsed and more than a thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Between Luo and Wei more than a thousand drowned as houses fell.

sentences.zh: 突厥登利可汗死。

translations.literal: Turkic Qaghan Dengli died.
translations.idiomatic: The Turkic qaghan Dengli died.

sentences.zh: 北州刺史王斛斯為幽州節度使；

translations.literal: Beizhou prefect Wang Sisi became Youzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sisi of Beizhou became Youzhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 幽州節度副使安祿山為營州刺史，充平廬軍節度副使，押兩番、渤海、黑水四府經略使。

translations.literal: Youzhou deputy commissioner An Lushan became Ying prefect, concurrent Pinglu deputy military commissioner, and commissioner overseeing two foreign offices, Parhae, and Heishui.
translations.idiomatic: An Lushan became Ying prefect, Pinglu deputy commissioner, and overseer of the frontier offices.

sentences.zh: 九月，大雨雪，稻禾偃折，又霖雨月餘，道途阻滯。

translations.literal: In the ninth month heavy snow bent the rice; rain lasted more than a month and roads were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month snow broke the rice; month-long rains blocked the roads.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河北博、洺等二十四州言雨水害稼，命御史中丞張倚往東都及河北賑恤之。

translations.literal: That autumn twenty-four Hebei prefectures including Bo and Ming reported rain damage to the crops; Censor-in-chief Zhang Yi was sent to the eastern capital and Hebei for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn twenty-four Hebei prefectures reported rain damage; Zhang Yi was sent to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御興慶門，試明《四子》人姚子產、元載等。

translations.literal: On renshen the emperor at Xingqing Gate tested candidates in the Four Masters—Yao Zichan, Yuan Zai, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he tested Four Masters candidates including Yao Zichan and Yuan Zai at Xingqing Gate.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on bingchen, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he visited the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，分遣大理卿崔翹等八人往諸道黜陟官吏。

translations.literal: On wuxu eight men including Director of the Court of Judicial Review Cui Qiao were sent to the circuits to judge officials.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Cui Qiao and seven others were sent to judge officials in the circuits.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，司空、邠王守禮薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengxu, Minister of Works Prince Bin Shouli died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Prince Bin Shouli, minister of works, died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，雨木冰，凝寒凍冽，數日不解。

translations.literal: On jisi trees bore ice; bitter cold froze for days without thaw.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi glaze ice bound the trees for days.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太尉、寧王憲薨，謚為讓皇帝，葬於惠陵。

translations.literal: On xinwei Grand Preceptor Prince Ning Xian died, posthumously styled Emperor Rang, and was buried at Hui Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Prince Ning Xian, grand preceptor, died, was styled Emperor Rang, and was buried at Hui.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，吐蕃入寇，陷廓州達化縣及振武軍石堡城，節度使蓋嘉運不能守。

translations.literal: On dingyou Tibet invaded, took Datong County of Kuo Prefecture and Zhenwu Army's Shibao fortress; commissioner Gai Jiayun could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Tibet took Kuo's Datong and Shibao fortress; Gai Jiayun could not hold.

sentences.zh: 女國王趙曳夫及佛逝國王、日南國王遣其子來朝獻。

translations.literal: Queen Zhao Yifu of the Women's Kingdom and the kings of Buddhist Zhiji and Rinan each sent sons to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Queens and kings of the Women's Kingdom, Buddhist Zhiji, and Rinan sent sons with tribute.

sentences.zh: 天寶元年春正月丁未朔，大赦天下，改元，常赦不原咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Tianbao 1, first spring month, dingwei new moon, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the era name was changed; even those normally unpardoned were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianbao 1, on the new moon, the court amnestied the realm, changed the era name, and pardoned even the usually excluded.

sentences.zh: 百姓所欠負租稅及諸色並免之。

translations.literal: Arrears of land tax and all other levies owed by the people were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The people's tax arrears and other levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 前資官及白身人有儒學博通、文辭秀逸及軍謀武藝者，所在具以名薦。

translations.literal: Former officials and commoners of broad Confucian learning, literary excellence, or military stratagem and martial skill were to be named by their prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Learned commoners and skilled warriors were to be recommended by their prefectures.

sentences.zh: 京文武官才堪為刺史者各令封狀自舉。

translations.literal: Capital civil and military officials fit to be prefects were each to submit sealed self-recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials fit for prefectures were to submit sealed self-recommendations.

sentences.zh: 改黃鉞為金鉞。

translations.literal: Yellow battle-axes were changed to gold battle-axes.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow battle-axes became gold.

sentences.zh: 內外官各賜勛兩轉。

translations.literal: Inside and outside officials each received two turns of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Court and provincial officials each gained two merit turns.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，陳王府參軍田同秀上言：「玄元皇帝降見於丹鳳門之通衢，告賜靈符在尹喜之故宅。

translations.literal: On jiayin Chen Prince mansion aide Tian Tongxiu memorialized: "The Xuan Yuan Emperor appeared in the open street before the Crimson Phoenix Gate, announcing that a numinous tally lay in the old home of Yin Xi."
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Tian Tongxiu reported that the Xuan Yuan Emperor had appeared before the Crimson Phoenix Gate, declaring a numinous tally at Yin Xi's old home.

sentences.zh: 」上遣使就函谷故關尹喜臺西發得之，乃置玄元廟於大寧坊。

translations.literal: The emperor sent men to dig west of the old Hangu Pass at Yin Xi's terrace and found it; an Xuan Yuan temple was placed in Daning ward.
translations.idiomatic: Messengers dug west of Hangu at Yin Xi's terrace, found the tally, and built an Xuan Yuan temple in Daning ward.

sentences.zh: 陜郡太守李齊物先鑿三門，辛未，渠成放流。

translations.literal: Shaan Prefecture prefect Li Qiwu had earlier cut the Three Gates; on xinwei the canal was opened and the waters released.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiwu of Shaan, who had cut the Three Gates, opened the canal on xinwei and released the flow.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，上加尊號為開元天寶聖文神武皇帝。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dinghai, the added honorific was Kaiyuan Tianbao Sage Literary Divine Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he took the honorific Kaiyuan Tianbao Sage Literary Divine Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，親享玄元皇帝於新廟。

translations.literal: On xinmao he personally offered to the Xuan Yuan Emperor at the new temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he sacrificed to the Xuan Yuan Emperor at the new temple.

sentences.zh: 甲午，親享太廟。

translations.literal: On jiawu he personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙申，合祭天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On bingshen heaven and earth were jointly sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he performed the joint suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 制天下囚徒，罪無輕重並釋放。

translations.literal: An edict released prisoners throughout the realm regardless of gravity.
translations.idiomatic: An edict released all prisoners regardless of crime.

sentences.zh: 流人移近處，左降官依資敘用，身死貶處者量加追贈。

translations.literal: Exiles were moved nearer; demoted officials were employed by qualification; those who died in exile received posthumous honors as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Exiles moved nearer; demoted officials were reemployed; dead exiles received measured posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 枉法贓十五疋當絞，今加至二十疋。

translations.literal: Fifteen bolts of corrupt goods had equaled strangulation; now it was raised to twenty bolts.
translations.idiomatic: The threshold for corrupt-goods strangulation rose from fifteen to twenty bolts.

sentences.zh: 莊子號為南華真人，文子號為通玄真人，列子號為沖虛真人，庚桑子號為洞虛真人。

translations.literal: Zhuangzi was styled Perfected Man of Southern Florescence; Wenzi Perfected Man of Pervasive Mystery; Liezi Perfected Man of Pervasive Vacuity; Gengsangzi Perfected Man of Pervasive Vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzi became Perfected Man of Southern Florescence; Wenzi of Pervasive Mystery; Liezi of Pervasive Vacuity; Gengsangzi of Pervasive Vacancy.

sentences.zh: 其四子所著書改為真經。

translations.literal: Their four books were changed to true scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: Their four books were renamed true scriptures.

sentences.zh: 崇玄學置博士、助教各一員，學生一百人。

translations.literal: Chongxuan schools received one erudite and one instructor each, with one hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxuan schools gained an erudite, an instructor, and a hundred students each.

sentences.zh: 桃林縣改為靈寶縣。

translations.literal: Taolin County was renamed Lingbao County.
translations.idiomatic: Taolin was renamed Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 改侍中為左相，中書令為右相，左右丞相依舊為僕射，又黃門侍郎為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant was changed to Left Chancellor, Secretariat Director to Right Chancellor; left and right vice directors remained as vice ministers; Yellow Gate Vice Director became Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant became left chancellor, secretariat director right chancellor; chancellery titles were reorganized.

sentences.zh: 東都為東京，北都為北京，天下諸州改為郡，刺史改為太守。

translations.literal: The eastern capital became Eastern Capital, the northern capital Northern Capital; all prefectures in the realm became commanderies and prefects became governors.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang became Eastern Capital, Taiyuan Northern Capital; prefectures became commanderies and prefects governors.

sentences.zh: 陜州河北縣為平陸縣。

translations.literal: Hebei County of Shan Prefecture became Pinglu County.
translations.idiomatic: Shan's Hebei County became Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 老幼版授，文武官三品已上加一爵，四品已下加一階。

translations.literal: The aged received provisional appointment; civil and military officials of third rank and above gained one noble rank, fourth and below one grade.
translations.idiomatic: The aged received provisional posts; third rank and above a noble rank, fourth and below a grade.

sentences.zh: 庚子，平盧節度使安祿山進階驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On gengzi Pinglu military commissioner An Lushan was advanced to Flying Cavalry Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi An Lushan was advanced to flying cavalry grand general.

sentences.zh: 夏六月庚寅，武功山水暴漲，壞人廬舍，溺死數百人。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on gengyin, mountain floods at Wugong burst, destroying houses and drowning several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Wugong floods destroyed houses and drowned hundreds.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on guimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，左相、豳國公牛仙客卒。

translations.literal: On xinwei Left Chancellor and Duke of Bin Niu Xianke died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Niu Xianke, left chancellor and Duke of Bin, died.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，刑部尚書、兼御史大夫李適之為左相。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Minister of Punishments and concurrent Censor-in-chief Li Shizhi became Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Li Shizhi, minister of punishments, became left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，突厥阿布思及默啜可汗之孫、登利可汗之女相與率其黨屬來降。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Turk Abu Si and the grandson of Qaghan Moqi and Qaghan Dengli's daughter each led their factions to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Turk Abu Si and Moqi's grandson, with Dengli's daughter, surrendered with their factions.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，吏部尚書兼右相李林甫加尚書左僕射，左相李適之兼兵部尚書，左僕射裴耀卿為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On renchen Minister of Personnel and concurrent Right Chancellor Li Linfu was made Left Vice Minister of Personnel; Left Chancellor Li Shizhi concurrent Minister of War; Left Vice Minister Pei Yaojun Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Li Linfu became left vice minister of personnel; Li Shizhi concurrent minister of war; Pei Yaojun right vice minister.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，上御花萼樓，出宮女宴毗伽可汗妻可登及男女等，賞賜不可勝紀。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinmao, the emperor at the Flower and Calyx Tower released palace women to feast Bilge Qaghan's wife Kedeng and her children; rewards were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month at the Flower and Calyx Tower he feasted Bilge's wife Kedeng with palace women and gave uncounted gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，改天下縣名不穩及重名一百一十處。

translations.literal: On bingyin one hundred ten unstable or duplicate county names throughout the realm were changed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin one hundred ten county names were changed for instability or duplication.

sentences.zh: 兩京玄元廟改為太上玄元皇帝宮，天下準此。

translations.literal: Xuan Yuan temples in the two capitals became Palaces of the Supreme Xuan Yuan Emperor; the realm followed.
translations.idiomatic: Capital Xuan Yuan temples became palaces of the Supreme Xuan Yuan Emperor; the realm followed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on dingyou, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he visited the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，改驪山為會昌山，仍於秦坑儒之所立祠宇，以祀遭難諸儒。

translations.literal: On xinchou Mount Li was renamed Mount Huichang; at the place where the First Emperor buried scholars a shrine was built to the scholars who suffered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Mount Li became Mount Huichang; a shrine rose where the First Emperor buried scholars.

sentences.zh: 新成長生殿名曰集靈臺，以祀天神。

translations.literal: The newly completed Hall of Long Life was renamed the Terrace of Gathering Spirits to sacrifice to the heavenly god.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Long Life was renamed Terrace of Gathering Spirits for heaven.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi, he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 是歲，命陜郡太守韋堅引滻水開廣運潭於望春亭之東，以通河、渭；

translations.literal: That year Shan Prefecture prefect Wei Jian drew the Chan River to open the Broad Transport Pool east of Wangchun Pavilion, joining the Yellow and Wei;
translations.idiomatic: That year Wei Jian of Shan drew the Chan to open the Broad Transport Pool east of Wangchun, joining the Yellow and Wei;

sentences.zh: 京兆尹韓朝宗又分渭水入自金光門，置潭於西市之兩衙，以貯材木。

translations.literal: Metropolitan prefect Han Chaozong also split the Wei into the Golden Light Gate and placed a pool in the west market's two wards to store timber.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chaozong split the Wei at Golden Light Gate and pooled timber in the west market.

sentences.zh: 是冬無冰。

translations.literal: That winter there was no ice.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no ice formed.

sentences.zh: 其年，天下郡府三百六十二，縣一千五百二十八，鄉一萬六千八百二十九。

translations.literal: That year the realm had three hundred sixty-two commandery prefectures, one thousand five hundred twenty-eight counties, and sixteen thousand eight hundred twenty-nine townships.
translations.idiomatic: That year the realm counted three hundred sixty-two commanderies, one thousand five hundred twenty-eight counties, and sixteen thousand eight hundred twenty-nine townships.

sentences.zh: 戶部進計帳，今年管戶八百五十二萬五千七百六十三，口四千八百九十萬九千八百。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue submitted the register: households this year eight million five hundred twenty-five thousand seven hundred sixty-three, mouths forty-eight million nine hundred nine thousand eight hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue reported eight million five hundred twenty-five thousand seven hundred sixty-three households and forty-eight million nine hundred nine thousand eight hundred mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶二年春正月丙辰，追尊玄元皇帝為大聖祖玄元皇帝，兩京崇玄學改為崇玄館，博士為學士。

translations.literal: Tianbao 2, first spring month, on bingchen, the Xuan Yuan Emperor was raised to Great Sage Ancestor Xuan Yuan Emperor; Chongxuan schools in the two capitals became Chongxuan Halls and erudites became academicians.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianbao 2 the Xuan Yuan Emperor was raised to Great Sage Ancestor; Chongxuan schools became halls and erudites academicians.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，親祀玄元廟以冊尊號。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renzi, he personally sacrificed at the Xuan Yuan temple to invest the new honorific.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he sacrificed at the Xuan Yuan temple to invest the new honorific.

sentences.zh: 制追尊聖祖玄元皇帝父周上御史大夫敬曰先天太上皇，母益壽氏號先天太后，仍於譙郡本鄉置廟。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously honored the Xuan Yuan Emperor's father, Zhou Superior Grand Master of the Palace Jing, as Proclaimed Supreme Emperor; his mother Lady Yishou as Proclaimed Empress; temples were placed in their native village in Qiao Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict honored the sage's father Jing as Proclaimed Supreme Emperor and his mother Lady Yishou as Proclaimed Empress, with temples in Qiao.

sentences.zh: 尊咎繇為德明皇帝。

translations.literal: Gao Yao was posthumously honored as Emperor Deming.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yao was posthumously enshrined as Emperor Deming.

sentences.zh: 改西京玄元廟為太清宮，東京為太微宮，天下諸郡為紫極宮。

translations.literal: The Xuan Yuan temple in the western capital was renamed Grand Pure Palace; in the eastern capital, Grand Aperture Palace; in all commanderies, Purple Pole Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The western capital's temple to the Mysterious Origin was renamed Grand Pure Palace; Luoyang's became Grand Aperture Palace; every commandery temple became Purple Pole Palace.

sentences.zh: 韋堅開廣運潭畢功，盛陳舟艦。

translations.literal: Wei Jian completed opening the Guangyun Canal and arrayed many ships in display.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jian finished the Guangyun Canal and staged a great fleet upon its waters.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上幸廣運樓以觀之，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin the emperor went to the Guangyun Tower to view them and returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the emperor visited the Guangyun Tower to watch the spectacle and returned to the palace that same day.

sentences.zh: 夏六月甲戌夜，雷震東京應天門觀災，延燒至左、右延福門，經日不滅。

translations.literal: On the night of jiaxu in the sixth summer month, lightning struck the Yingtian Gate observatory in the eastern capital; fire spread to the left and right Yanfu gates and burned for a day without going out.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiaxu in the sixth summer month lightning shattered the Yingtian Gate observatory at Luoyang; flames reached the Yanfu gates on either side and burned all day without dying.

sentences.zh: 七月癸丑，致仕禮部尚書王丘卒。

translations.literal: On guichou of the seventh month, retired minister of rites Wang Qiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the seventh month Wang Qiu, retired minister of rites, died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，尚書右僕射裴耀卿薨。

translations.literal: On bingchen, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs Pei Yaoqing died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Pei Yaoqing, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, died.

sentences.zh: 九月，太子少保崔琳卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, junior tutor of the heir apparent Cui Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Cui Lin, junior tutor of the heir apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，譙郡紫極宮改為太清宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Purple Pole Palace in Qiao commandery was renamed Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Purple Pole Palace in Qiao commandery was renamed Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，太子太保、信安王禕卒。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the tenth winter month, heir apparent grand protector and Prince of Xin'an Li Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the tenth winter month Li Yi, heir apparent grand protector and Prince of Xin'an, died.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he went to the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he went to the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On yimao of the eleventh month, he returned from the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the eleventh month he returned from the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，東京應天門改為乾元門。

translations.literal: On jihai of the twelfth month, the Yingtian Gate of the eastern capital was renamed Qianyuan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the twelfth month Luoyang's Yingtian Gate was renamed Qianyuan Gate.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On wushen, he went to the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he went to the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On bingchen, he returned from the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he returned from the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，太子賓客賀知章請度為道士還鄉。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the twelfth month, heir apparent guest He Zhizhang requested to be ordained a Daoist and return home.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the twelfth month He Zhizhang, guest of the heir apparent, asked to take Daoist orders and go home.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 天寶三載三載正月丙辰朔，改年為載。

translations.literal: On the new moon of bingchen, first month of Tianbao 3, the era name was changed so that nian became zai.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the first month of Tianbao 3 the era word nian was changed to zai.

sentences.zh: 赦見禁囚徒。

translations.literal: An amnesty was granted to prisoners in custody.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was granted to prisoners still in custody.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣左右相已下祖別賀知章於長樂坡，上賦詩贈之。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the left and right chancellors and officials below escorted He Zhizhang to bid farewell at Changle Slope; the emperor composed a poem and presented it as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the left and right chancellors and all officials below them saw He Zhizhang off at Changle Slope; the emperor wrote him a parting poem.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On renyin, he went to the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he went to the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，還京。

translations.literal: On jisi of the second month, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the second month he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封讓皇帝男琳為嗣寧王，故邠王守禮男承寧為嗣邠王，讓帝男璹為嗣申王，惠宣太子男珍為嗣岐王，員為嗣薛王。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the emperor's younger brother Lin was made successor Prince of Ning; the former Prince of Bin's son Chengning was made successor Prince of Bin; the emperor's younger brother Shan was made successor Prince of Shen; the late Prince Huixuan's son Zhen was made successor Prince of Qi; Yuan was made successor Prince of Xue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Lin was made successor Prince of Ning; Chengning, son of the former Prince of Bin, successor Prince of Bin; Shan successor Prince of Shen; Zhen, son of the late Prince Huixuan, successor Prince of Qi; and Yuan successor Prince of Xue.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，皇太子紹改名亨。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the crown prince Shao was renamed Heng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the crown prince Shao was renamed Heng.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南尹裴敦復卒。

translations.literal: That month, Henan intendant Pei Dunfu died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Pei Dunfu, intendant of Henan, died.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛亥，有星如月，墜於東南，墜後有聲。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the intercalary month, a star like the moon fell in the southeast; after it fell there was a sound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the intercalary month a moon-sized star fell in the southeast, and a sound followed its fall.

sentences.zh: 京師訛言官遣棖捕人肝以祭天狗。

translations.literal: Rumors spread in the capital that officials were sending sticks to seize people's livers for sacrifice to the Heavenly Dog.
translations.idiomatic: The capital buzzed with rumor that the court was dispatching clubs to seize human livers as offerings to the Heavenly Dog.

sentences.zh: 人相恐，畿縣尤甚，發使安之。

translations.literal: People were mutually terrified; the metropolitan counties were especially affected; envoys were sent to reassure them.
translations.idiomatic: Panic spread among the people, worst in the metropolitan counties; the court sent envoys to calm them.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，武威郡上言：番禾縣天寶山有醴泉湧出，嶺石化為瑞麰，遠近貧乏者取以給食。

translations.literal: On gengwu of the third month, Wuwei commandery reported that at Mount Tianbao in Fanhe county a sweet spring had welled up and ridge stones had turned into auspicious wheat; the poor from near and far took it for food.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the third month Wuwei reported that at Mount Tianbao in Fanhe a sweet spring had burst forth and cliff stone had become miraculous grain, which the poor came from far and near to eat.

sentences.zh: 改番禾為天寶縣。

translations.literal: Fanhe was renamed Tianbao county.
translations.idiomatic: Fanhe county was renamed Tianbao.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，制天下見禁囚徒死罪降流，流已下並原之。

translations.literal: On guiyou, an edict ordered that among prisoners in custody, those sentenced to death were reduced to exile, and those exiled or below were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict commuted death sentences to exile and pardoned all prisoners at exile or below.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，南海太守劉巨鱗擊破海賊吳令光，永嘉郡平。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, Nanhai protector Liu Juxi defeated the pirate Wu Lingguang and pacified Yongjia commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Liu Juxi, protector of Nanhai, crushed the pirate Wu Lingguang and pacified Yongjia commandery.

sentences.zh: 敕兩京、天下州郡取官物鑄金銅天尊及佛各一軀，送開元觀、開元寺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered commanderies in both capitals and throughout the empire to cast one bronze statue each of the Heavenly Worthy and of the Buddha from official goods, and send them to Kaiyuan Abbey and Kaiyuan Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered every commandery in the two capitals and the realm to cast from official bronze one image each of the Heavenly Worthy and the Buddha and send them to Kaiyuan Abbey and Kaiyuan Monastery.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，長安令柳升坐贓，於朝堂決殺之。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the fifth month, Chang'an magistrate Liu Sheng was executed in the court hall for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the fifth month Liu Sheng, magistrate of Chang'an, was beaten to death in open court for corruption.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙午，九姓拔悉密葉護攻殺突厥烏蘇米施可汗，傳首京師。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the eighth autumn month, the Basmyl qaghan of the Nine Surnames attacked and killed the Turk qaghan Wushimi, and his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the eighth autumn month the Basmyl qaghan of the Nine Surnames slew the Turk qaghan Wushimi and sent his head to court.

sentences.zh: 庚申，內外文武官六品已下，自今已後，赴任之後，計載終滿二百日已上，許其成考。

translations.literal: On gengshen, civil and military officials inside and outside the court from sixth rank downward were hereafter, after taking up their posts, allowed to complete their merit review upon two hundred full days of service.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict granted civil and military officials of sixth rank and below, once two hundred days in post had elapsed, the right to a completed merit review.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On guisi of the tenth winter month, he went to the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the tenth winter month he went to the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，改史國為來威國。

translations.literal: On dingwei, State of Shi was renamed State of Laiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the State of Shi was renamed State of Laiwei.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，還京。

translations.literal: On guimao of the eleventh month, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the eleventh month he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，每載依舊取正月十四日、十五日、十六日開坊市門燃燈，永以為常式。

translations.literal: On guichou, each zai as before on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and sixteenth of the first month the ward gates were opened and lamps lit—a perpetual statute.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou it was made perpetual law that on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and sixteenth of the first month each year ward gates should open and festival lamps burn.

sentences.zh: 玉真公主先為女道士，讓號及實封，賜名持盈。

translations.literal: Princess Yuzhen had earlier become a female Daoist; she was granted title and a substantive fief, and the name Chiying was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Yuzhen, already a female Daoist, received a title and substantive fief; the name Chiying was bestowed on her.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，分新豐縣置會昌縣。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the twelfth month, Huichang county was established by dividing Xinfeng county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the twelfth month Huichang county was carved from Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，親祀九宮貴神於東郊，禮畢，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he personally sacrificed to the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits at the eastern suburban altar; when the rites were finished, a great amnesty was granted throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he sacrificed in person to the Nine Palaces spirits at the eastern suburb; when the rites ended he proclaimed a great amnesty for the realm.

sentences.zh: 百姓十八已上為中男，二十三已上成丁。

translations.literal: Commoners eighteen and above were made zhongnan; twenty-three and above counted as adult males.
translations.idiomatic: Men eighteen and older were classed as zhongnan; at twenty-three they counted as adult males liable for service.

sentences.zh: 每歲庸調，八月起征，可延至九月。

translations.literal: Each year's corvée and land-tax levy was to begin collection in the eighth month and could be extended to the ninth.
translations.idiomatic: Annual corvée and land-tax collection might begin in the eighth month and run into the ninth.

sentences.zh: 詔天下民間家藏《孝經》一本。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that every household throughout the empire keep one copy of the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required every household in the empire to keep a copy of the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 天寶四載四載春三月甲申，宴群臣於勤政樓。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the third spring month of Tianbao 4, he feasted the host of officials at the Qinzheng Tower.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the third spring month of Tianbao 4 he feasted the officials at the Qinzheng Tower.

sentences.zh: 壬申，封外孫獨孤氏女為靜樂公主，出降契丹松漠都督李懷節；

translations.literal: On renshen, an external granddaughter of the Dugu clan was created Princess Jingle and married to Khitan Songmo protector Li Huaijie.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen a Dugu granddaughter was created Princess Jingle and sent to marry Khitan Songmo protector Li Huaijie.

sentences.zh: 封外孫楊氏女為宜芳公主，出降奚饒樂都督李延寵。

translations.literal: An external granddaughter of the Yang clan was created Princess Yifang and married to Xi Raole protector Li Yanchong.
translations.idiomatic: A Yang granddaughter was created Princess Yifang and sent to marry Xi Raole protector Li Yanchong.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲辰，冊太真妃楊氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the eighth autumn month, Noble Consort True Yang was installed as imperial consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the eighth autumn month Lady Yang, consort of Taizhen rank, was elevated to imperial consort.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南睢陽、淮陽、譙等八郡大水。

translations.literal: That month, eight commanderies including Suiyang, Huaiyang, and Qiao in Henan suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That month great floods struck eight Henan commanderies, including Suiyang, Huaiyang, and Qiao.

sentences.zh: 九月，契丹及奚酋長各殺公主，舉部落叛。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Khitan and Xi chieftains each killed their princesses and rose in rebellion with their tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Khitan and Xi chiefs each slew their Tang princesses and led their tribes in revolt.

sentences.zh: 隴右節度使皇甫惟明與吐蕃戰於石堡城，官軍不利，副將褚直廉等死之。

translations.literal: Longyou military commissioner Huangfu Weiming fought Tibetans at Stone Fortress City; the government army was unsuccessful and deputy commander Chu Zhilian and others were killed.
translations.idiomatic: At Stone Fortress City Huangfu Weiming, commissioner of Longyou, fought Tibetans and lost; deputy commander Chu Zhilian and others fell.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，於單于都護府置金河縣，安北都護府置陰山縣。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, Jinhe county was established at the Chanyu Protectorate and Yinshan county at the Anbei Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Jinhe county was set up under the Chanyu Protectorate and Yinshan under Anbei.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he went to the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以會昌縣為同京縣。

translations.literal: On renzi, Huichang county was made Tongjing county.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Huichang county was renamed Tongjing.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，還京。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the twelfth month, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the twelfth month he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 天寶五載五載春正月癸酉，刑部尚書韋堅貶括蒼太守；

translations.literal: On guiyou of the first spring month of Tianbao 5, minister of punishments Wei Jian was demoted to protector of Kuocang;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the first spring month of Tianbao 5 Wei Jian, minister of punishments, was demoted to protector of Kuocang;

sentences.zh: 隴右節度使皇甫惟明貶播川太守，尋決死於黔中。

translations.literal: Longyou military commissioner Huangfu Weiming was demoted to protector of Bo River; soon both were ordered executed in Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Weiming, commissioner of Longyou, was demoted to protector of Bo River—and soon both men were ordered executed in Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，敕大小縣令並準畿官吏三選聽集。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict ordered that magistrates of large and small counties alike would, like metropolitan officials, complete three selections before being summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict required magistrates of every county, like capital officials, to pass three selections before being summoned.

sentences.zh: 《禮記月令》改為《時令》。

translations.literal: Record of Rites Monthly Ordinances was renamed Seasonal Ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Rites Monthly Ordinances was retitled Seasonal Ordinances.

sentences.zh: 封中岳為中天王，南岳為司天王，北岳為安天王。

translations.literal: Mount Song was enfeoffed as King of Central Heaven, Mount Heng of the south as King of Heaven of Offices, Mount Heng of the north as King of Peaceful Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Song was enfeoffed King of Central Heaven; the southern Mount Heng, King of Heaven of Offices; the northern Mount Heng, King of Peaceful Heaven.

sentences.zh: 天下山水，名稱或同，義且不經，多因於里諺，宜令所司各據圖籍改定。

translations.literal: Mountains and waters throughout the empire—many names duplicated or were improper, often from vulgar local sayings; the relevant offices were ordered to correct them according to maps and registers.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains and rivers across the realm bore duplicate or improper names, many from vulgar local usage; each office was ordered to rectify them against the official maps.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣禮部尚書席豫、左丞崔翹、御史中丞王鉷等七人分行天下，黜陟官吏。

translations.literal: On bingzi, minister of rites Xi Yu and left assistant director Cui Qiao, censor-in-chief Wang Hong, and seven others were dispatched throughout the empire to promote and demote officials.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Xi Yu, minister of rites, Cui Qiao, left assistant director, Wang Hong, censor-in-chief, and seven others were sent through the realm to promote and demote officials.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，左相、渭源伯李適之為太子少保，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the fourth summer month, left chancellor and Count of Weiyuan Li Shizhi became grand protector of the heir apparent and ceased to manage government.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the fourth summer month Li Shizhi, left chancellor and Count of Weiyuan, became grand protector of the heir apparent and left the council.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，門下侍郎陳希烈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Yellow Gate vice minister Chen Xilie became co-equal Zhongshu Menxia chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Chen Xilie, yellow gate vice minister, joined the council as co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，敕今後每至旬節休假，中書門下文武百僚不須入朝，外官不須衙集。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the fifth month, an edict ordered that on each decanal holiday the Zhongshu Menxia civil and military officials need not attend court, and outside officials need not assemble at their yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the fifth month an edict freed Zhongshu Menxia officials from court on decanal holidays and outside officials from yamen assembly.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，停郡縣差丁白直課錢。

translations.literal: On guimao, the county practice of assessing white-service corvée money was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the counties ceased levying white-service corvée money.

sentences.zh: 六月，敕三伏內令宰相辰時還宅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict ordered that during the three fu periods chancellors might return home at chen hour.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month an edict allowed chancellors to leave office at chen hour during the three fu periods.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，韋堅為李林甫所構，配流臨封郡，賜死。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the seventh autumn month, Wei Jian was framed by Li Linfu, sentenced to exile to Linfeng commandery, and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the seventh autumn month Li Linfu framed Wei Jian; sentenced to exile at Linfeng, he was granted death.

sentences.zh: 堅妹皇太子妃聽離，堅外甥嗣薛王員貶夷陵郡別駕，女婿巴陵太守盧幼臨長流合浦郡。

translations.literal: Wei Jian's sister, the crown prince's consort, was ordered to divorce; his external nephew, successor Prince of Xue Yuan, was demoted to Baling prefect; his son-in-law Baling protector Lu Youlin was exiled far to Hepu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jian's sister, the crown prince's consort, was made to divorce; his nephew, successor Prince of Xue Yuan, was demoted to Baling prefect; his son-in-law Lu Youlin, protector of Baling, was exiled to Hepu.

sentences.zh: 太子少保李適之貶宜春太守，到任，飲藥死。

translations.literal: Grand protector of the heir apparent Li Shizhi was demoted to Yichun protector; upon reaching his post he took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shizhi, grand protector of the heir apparent, was demoted to Yichun; on reaching his post he drank poison and died.

sentences.zh: 八月，以戶部侍郎郭虛己為御史大夫、劍南節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, vice minister of revenue Guo Xuji was made censor-in-chief and Jiannan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Guo Xuji, vice minister of revenue, became censor-in-chief and Jiannan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，於太清宮刻石為李林甫、陳希烈像，侍於聖容之側。

translations.literal: On renzi of the ninth month, stone images of Li Linfu and Chen Xilie were carved at the Grand Pure Palace and placed beside the sage's portrait.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the ninth month stone images of Li Linfu and Chen Xilie were carved at the Grand Pure Palace and set beside the sage's likeness.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the tenth winter month, he went to the hot springs palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the tenth winter month he went to the hot springs palace.

sentences.zh: 改臨淄郡為濟南郡。

translations.literal: Linzi commandery was renamed Jinan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Linzi commandery was renamed Jinan.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，還京。

translations.literal: On jisi of the eleventh month, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the eleventh month he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，贊善大夫杜有鄰、著作郎王曾、左驍衛兵曹柳勣等為李林甫所構，並下獄死。
