translations.literal: On xinwei of the twelfth month, good-order grandee Du Youlin, Director of Composition Wang Zeng, left Yaoqiwei military assessor Liu Ji, and others were framed by Li Linfu; all were imprisoned and put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the twelfth month Du Youlin, good-order grandee, Wang Zeng, director of composition, Liu Ji, left Yaoqiwei assessor, and others were framed by Li Linfu and died in prison.

sentences.zh: 天寶六載六載正月辛巳朔，北海太守李邕、淄川太守裴敦復並以事連王曾、柳勣，遣使就殺之。

translations.literal: On the new moon of xinsi, first month of Tianbao 6, Beihai protector Li Yong and Zichuan protector Pei Dunfu, implicated through Wang Zeng and Liu Ji, were dispatched and killed on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the first month of Tianbao 6 Li Yong of Beihai and Pei Dunfu of Zichuan, implicated through Wang Zeng and Liu Ji, were met on the road and executed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，親享太廟。

translations.literal: On dinghai, he personally sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he sacrificed in person at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，親祀圜丘，禮畢，大赦天下，除絞、斬刑，但決重杖。

translations.literal: On wuzi, he personally sacrificed at the Round Altar; when the rites were finished a great amnesty was granted throughout the empire; strangulation and decapitation were removed—only heavy beating was imposed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he sacrificed at the Round Altar; when the rites ended he proclaimed a great amnesty, abolishing strangulation and decapitation in favor of heavy rod punishment.

sentences.zh: 於京城置三皇、五帝廟，以時享祭。

translations.literal: Temples to the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors were established in the capital and sacrifices were offered seasonally.
translations.idiomatic: Temples to the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors were built in the capital and honored on the seasonal schedule.

sentences.zh: 其章懷、節愍、惠莊、惠文、惠宣等太子，宜與隱太子、懿德太子同為一廟。

translations.literal: Crown princes Zhanghuai, Jiemin, Huizhuang, Huiwen, and Huixuan should share one temple with the hidden crown prince and the Posthumous Virtue crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Crown princes Zhanghuai, Jiemin, Huizhuang, Huiwen, and Huixuan were to share one temple with the Hidden Crown Prince and the Posthumous Virtue Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 每日立仗食及設仗於庭，此後並宜停廢。

translations.literal: Daily standing-ration food and setting guards in the courtyard were afterward all to be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Daily rations for the standing guard and the courtyard guard-mount were abolished.

sentences.zh: 五岳既已封王，四瀆當升公位，封河瀆為靈源公，濟瀆為清源公，江瀆為廣源公，淮瀆為長源公。

translations.literal: Since the five sacred mountains had been enfeoffed as kings, the four streams should be raised to duke: Yellow River as Duke of Spiritual Source, Ji as Duke of Clear Source, Yangtze as Duke of Broad Source, Huai as Duke of Long Source.
translations.idiomatic: With the five mountains already enfeoffed as kings, the four rivers were raised to duke: the Yellow River, Duke of Spiritual Source; the Ji, Duke of Clear Source; the Yangtze, Duke of Broad Source; the Huai, Duke of Long Source.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，南海太守彭果坐贓，決杖，長流溱溪郡，死於路。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the third month, Nanhai protector Peng Guo was convicted of corruption, beaten with the staff, and exiled far to Qinxi commandery; he died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the third month Peng Guo, protector of Nanhai, was beaten for corruption and exiled to Qinxi; he died on the way.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，門下侍郎陳希烈為左相兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the fourth summer month, Yellow Gate vice minister Chen Xilie became left chancellor and concurrent minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the fourth summer month Chen Xilie became left chancellor and minister of war.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復置軍器監。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Directorate of Armaments was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Directorate of Armaments was restored.

sentences.zh: 自五月不雨至秋七月。

translations.literal: From the fifth month there was no rain until the seventh autumn month.
translations.idiomatic: From the fifth month no rain fell until the seventh autumn month.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以旱，命宰相、臺寺、府縣錄系囚，死罪決杖配流，徒已下特免。

translations.literal: On yiyou, because of drought, chancellors, censorial and temple offices, and prefectural and county authorities were ordered to record prisoners in custody; death sentences were commuted to beating and exile, and penal servitude and below were specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, with drought gripping the land, chancellors, censorial and temple offices, and every prefecture and county were ordered to review prisoners; death sentences became beating and exile, and penal servitude or less was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅始雨。

translations.literal: On gengyin rain began.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin rain at last fell.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，幸溫泉宮，改為華清宮。

translations.literal: On wushen of the tenth winter month, he went to the hot springs palace, which was renamed Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the tenth winter month he went to the hot springs palace, now renamed Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，戶部侍郎楊慎矜及兄少府少監慎餘與弟洛陽令慎名，並為李林甫及御史中丞王鉷所構，下獄死。

translations.literal: On yihai of the eleventh month, vice minister of revenue Yang Shenjin and his elder brother, vice director of the palace workshops Shenyu, and his younger brother Luoyang magistrate Shenming were all framed by Li Linfu and censor-in-chief Wang Hong and died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the eleventh month Yang Shenjin, vice minister of revenue, his brother Shenyu of the palace workshops, and his brother Shenming, magistrate of Luoyang, were framed by Li Linfu and Wang Hong and died in prison.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，工部尚書陸景融卒。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the twelfth month, minister of works Lu Jingrong died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the twelfth month Lu Jingrong, minister of works, died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，還京。

translations.literal: On renxu, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 天寶七載七載春正月己卯，禮部尚書席豫卒。

translations.literal: On jimao of the first spring month of Tianbao 7, minister of rites Xi Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the first spring month of Tianbao 7 Xi Yu, minister of rites, died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，韋絳奏御案褥袱帷等望去紫用赤黃，從之。

translations.literal: On jihai, Wei Jiang memorialized that imperial couch quilts, drapes, curtains, etc. should remove purple and use red-yellow; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wei Jiang asked that imperial bedding and hangings drop purple for red-yellow; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，大同殿柱產玉芝，有神光照殿。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the third month, a jade fungus grew on a pillar of the Datong Hall, with divine light illuminating the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the third month a jade fungus sprouted on a Datong Hall pillar, and a sacred light filled the hall.

sentences.zh: 群臣請加皇帝尊號曰開元天寶聖文神武應道，許之。

translations.literal: The host of officials requested adding to the emperor's honorific title "Kaiyuan Tianbao Sacred-Cultured Divinely Martial Responsive-to-the-Way"; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Officials petitioned to add to the emperor's honorific the phrase Kaiyuan Tianbao Sacred-Cultured Divinely Martial Responsive-to-the-Way; he assented.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，以高力士為驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the fourth summer month, Gao Lishi was made chief general of swift cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the fourth summer month Gao Lishi was made chief general of swift cavalry.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，上御興慶宮，受冊徽號，大赦天下，百姓免來載租庸。

translations.literal: On renwu of the fifth month, the emperor went to Xingqing Palace, received the seal of the honorific title, granted a great amnesty throughout the empire, and exempted the people from the coming year's corvée and land tax.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the fifth month he went to Xingqing Palace to receive the honorific seal, proclaimed a great amnesty, and remitted the people's corvée and land tax for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 三皇以前帝王，京城置廟，以時致祭。

translations.literal: For emperors before the Three Sovereigns, temples were established in the capital and sacrifices offered seasonally.
translations.idiomatic: For pre-Three Sovereigns emperors, temples were built in the capital and honored on the seasonal schedule.

sentences.zh: 其歷代帝王肇跡之處未有祠守者，所在各置一廟。

translations.literal: Where former emperors had first risen but no shrine kept watch, each place was to establish one temple.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever an ancient emperor had first risen and no shrine yet stood, a temple was to be built on the spot.

sentences.zh: 忠臣、義士、孝婦、烈女德行彌高者，亦置祠宇致祭。

translations.literal: Loyal ministers, righteous warriors, filial daughters, and chaste women of the highest virtue were also granted shrines and sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines were likewise ordained for loyal ministers, righteous warriors, filial daughters, and women of blazing chastity.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日。

translations.literal: A feast of three days was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted a three-day feast.

sentences.zh: 六月，范陽節度使安祿山賜實封及鐵券。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Fanyang military commissioner An Lushan was granted a substantive fief and an iron certificate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month An Lushan, commissioner of Fanyang, received a substantive fief and an iron certificate of grace.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己亥朔，改千秋節為天長節。

translations.literal: On the new moon of jihai of the eighth autumn month, the Thousand Autumns Festival was renamed the Eternal Heaven Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the eighth autumn month the Thousand Autumns Festival was renamed Eternal Heaven Festival.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改萬年縣為咸寧縣。

translations.literal: On renzi, Wannian county was renamed Xianning county.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wannian county was renamed Xianning.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，幸華清宮，封貴妃姊二人為韓國、虢國夫人。

translations.literal: On gengwu of the tenth winter month, he went to Huaqing Palace and enfeoffed the imperial consort's two elder sisters as Ladies of Han and Guo states.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the tenth winter month he went to Huaqing Palace and created the consort's two elder sisters Ladies of Han and Guo.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，言玄元皇帝見於華清宮之朝元閣，乃改為降聖閣。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the twelfth month, the Mysterious Origin Emperor was said to have appeared in the Chaoyuan Pavilion at Huaqing Palace; the pavilion was therefore renamed the Descent of the Sage Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the twelfth month the Mysterious Origin Emperor was said to have appeared in Huaqing Palace's Chaoyuan Pavilion, which was renamed Descent of the Sage Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 改會昌縣為昭應縣，會昌山為昭應山；

translations.literal: Huichang county was renamed Zhaoying county, and Huichang Mountain Zhaoying Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: Huichang county became Zhaoying, and Huichang Mountain Zhaoying Mountain;

sentences.zh: 封山神為玄德公，仍立祠宇。

translations.literal: the mountain spirit was enfeoffed as Duke of Mysterious Virtue, and a shrine was established.
translations.idiomatic: its spirit was enfeoffed Duke of Mysterious Virtue, and a shrine was built.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，還京。

translations.literal: On xinyou, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 天寶八載八載春正月甲申，賜京官絹，備春時游賞。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the first spring month of Tianbao 8, silk was granted to capital officials for spring outings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the first spring month of Tianbao 8 capital officials received silk for spring outings.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，引百官於左藏庫縱觀錢幣，賜絹而歸。

translations.literal: On wushen of the second month, the hundred officials were led to view the coin storehouse of the left treasury and were given silk on returning.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the second month officials were led through the left treasury to gaze on its coin hoard and sent home with gifts of silk.

sentences.zh: 三月，朔方節度使張齊丘於中受降城北築橫塞城。

translations.literal: In the third month, Shuofang military commissioner Zhang Qiqiu built Hengsai Fort north of the central surrender city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhang Qiqiu, commissioner of Shuofang, built Hengsai Fort north of the central surrender city.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，咸寧太守趙奉璋決杖而死，著作郎韋子春貶端溪尉，李林甫陷之也。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, Xianning protector Zhao Fengzhang was beaten to death with the staff, and Director of Composition Wei Zichun was demoted to magistrate of Duanxi—Li Linfu had framed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Zhao Fengzhang, protector of Xianning, was beaten to death and Wei Zichun, director of composition, demoted to Duanxi magistrate—Li Linfu had engineered it.

sentences.zh: 幸華清宮觀風樓。

translations.literal: He went to Huaqing Palace to view the Wind Tower.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Huaqing Palace to visit the Wind Tower.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，於開遠門外作振旅亭。

translations.literal: On xinsi of the fifth month, the Pacifying Army Pavilion was built outside Kaiyuan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the fifth month the Pacifying Army Pavilion was erected outside Kaiyuan Gate.

sentences.zh: 戊子，南海太守劉巨鱗坐贓，決死之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Nanhai protector Liu Juxi was convicted of corruption and ordered executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Liu Juxi, protector of Nanhai, was convicted of corruption and executed.

sentences.zh: 六月，大同殿又產玉芝一莖。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, another stalk of jade fungus grew in the Datong Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month another jade fungus sprouted in the Datong Hall.

sentences.zh: 隴右節度使哥舒翰攻吐蕃石堡城，拔之。

translations.literal: Longyou military commissioner Geshu Han attacked the Tibetan Stone Fortress City and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Geshu Han, commissioner of Longyou, stormed the Tibetan Stone Fortress and took it.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，改石堡城為神武軍。

translations.literal: On the intercalary jichou, Stone Fortress City was renamed Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary jichou Stone Fortress was renamed Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 劍南索磨川新置都護府，宜以保寧為名。

translations.literal: At Suomo River in Jiannan a new protectorate was established; it should take the name Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: A new protectorate on the Suomo in Jiannan was to be called Baoning.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上親謁太清宮，冊聖祖玄元皇帝尊號為聖祖大道玄元皇帝。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the emperor personally visited the Grand Pure Palace and enfeoffed the sage ancestor the Mysterious Origin Emperor with the honorific Sage Ancestor Great Way Mysterious Origin Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he visited the Grand Pure Palace in person and enfeoffed the sage ancestor as Sage Ancestor Great Way Mysterious Origin Emperor.

sentences.zh: 高祖、太宗、高宗、中宗、睿宗五帝，皆加「大聖皇帝」之字；

translations.literal: Gaozu, Taizong, Gaozong, Zhongzong, and Ruizong, the five emperors, all had the words "Great Sage Emperor" added;
translations.idiomatic: To Gaozu, Taizong, Gaozong, Zhongzong, and Ruizong was added the epithet Great Sage Emperor;

sentences.zh: 太穆、文德、則天、和思、昭皇后，皆加「順聖皇后」之字。

translations.literal: Empresses Taimu, Wende, Zetian, Heside, and Zhao all had the words "Obedient Sage Empress" added.
translations.idiomatic: to Empresses Taimu, Wende, Zetian, Heside, and Zhao, Obedient Sage Empress.

sentences.zh: 群臣上皇帝尊號為開元天地大寶聖文神武應道皇帝。

translations.literal: The host of officials submitted the emperor's honorific as Emperor Kaiyuan Heaven-and-Earth Great Treasure Sacred-Cultured Divinely Martial Responsive-to-the-Way.
translations.idiomatic: Officials offered the emperor the title Kaiyuan Heaven-and-Earth Great Treasure Sacred-Cultured Divinely Martial Responsive-to-the-Way.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上御含元殿受冊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the emperor went to the Hall of Encompassing Primacy to receive the seal and granted a great amnesty throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he received the seal in the Hall of Encompassing Primacy and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 自今後每至禘祫，並於太清宮聖祖前序昭穆。

translations.literal: Henceforth at each di and xia sacrifice the sequence of zhao and mu was to begin before the sage ancestor at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth at every di and xia rite the zhao-mu order was to begin before the sage ancestor in the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 初，太白山人李渾言太白山金星洞有帝福壽玉版石記，求得之，乃封太白山為神應公，金星洞為嘉祥公，所管華陽縣為貞符縣。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Taibai Mountain man Li Hun said that in the Golden Star Grotto of Taibai Mountain there was a jade plaque stone record of the emperor's fortune and longevity; when it was obtained, Taibai Mountain was enfeoffed as Duke of Divine Response, the Golden Star Grotto as Duke of Auspicious Blessing, and the Huayang county under its jurisdiction as Zhenfu county.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Li Hun of Taibai Mountain had claimed a jade plaque in the Golden Star Grotto foretelling imperial fortune and long life; when it was found, Taibai was enfeoffed Duke of Divine Response, the grotto Duke of Auspicious Blessing, and Huayang county renamed Zhenfu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太子太師、徐國公蕭嵩薨。

translations.literal: On wuchen, heir apparent grand tutor and Duke of Xu Xiao Song died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Xiao Song, heir apparent grand tutor and Duke of Xu, died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，南衙立仗馬宜停，省進馬官。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the southern yamen standing horses should cease; the office supplying horses was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the southern yamen's parade horses were abolished and the horse-supply office cut back.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊子，郡別駕宜停，下郡置長史。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the eighth autumn month, commandery vice-prefects should cease; in lower commanderies a chief administrator was to be set.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the eighth autumn month commandery vice-prefects were abolished; lower commanderies were given chief administrators instead.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，幸華清宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the tenth winter month, he went to Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the tenth winter month he went to Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，幸御史中丞楊釗莊。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the eleventh month, he visited the estate of censor-in-chief Yang Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the eleventh month he visited the manor of Yang Zhao, censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 天寶九載九載春正月庚寅朔，與歲次同始，受朝於華清宮。

translations.literal: On the new moon of gengyin, first month of Tianbao 9, the new moon coincided with the year's beginning; he received court at Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the first month of Tianbao 9 the year began with the new moon; he held court at Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，還京。

translations.literal: On jihai, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，群臣請封西嶽，從之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the host of officials requested enfeoffing the western sacred mountain; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu officials petitioned to enfeoff the western sacred mountain; he assented.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，御史中丞宋渾坐贓及奸，長流高要郡。

translations.literal: On renwu of the second month, censor-in-chief Song Hun was convicted of corruption and debauchery and exiled far to Gaoyao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the second month Song Hun, censor-in-chief, was convicted of corruption and debauchery and exiled to Gaoyao.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，改匭使為獻納。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the third month, the Petition Box commissioner was renamed Petition Presenter.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the third month the Petition Box commissioner was retitled Petition Presenter.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，西嶽廟災。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the western sacred mountain temple burned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the western sacred mountain temple burned.

sentences.zh: 時久旱，制停封西嶽。

translations.literal: Because drought had long continued, an edict halted enfeoffing the western sacred mountain.
translations.idiomatic: With drought unbroken, an edict suspended the western mountain enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚寅，以旱，錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the fifth summer month, because of drought, prisoners were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the fifth summer month prisoners were reviewed because of drought.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，安祿山進封東平郡王。

translations.literal: On yimao, An Lushan was advanced to Prince of Dongping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao An Lushan was created Prince of Dongping commandery.

sentences.zh: 節度使封王，自此始也。

translations.literal: Enfeoffing a military commissioner as prince began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The enfeoffment of a frontier commissioner as prince began here.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，國子監置廣文館，領生徒為進士業者。

translations.literal: On jihai of the seventh autumn month, the Directorate of Education established the Broad Culture Hall for students pursuing the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the seventh autumn month the Directorate of Education opened the Broad Culture Hall for jinshi candidates.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，處士崔昌上《五行應運歷》，以國家合承周、漢，請廢周、隋不合為二王後。

translations.literal: On yimao of the ninth month, the recluse Cui Chang submitted the Cyclical Record of the Five Phases in Accord with Fortune, arguing that the state should inherit Zhou and Han and requesting abolition of Zhou and Sui as unfit to remain among the two former dynasties honored after abdication.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the ninth month the recluse Cui Chang submitted his Cyclical Record of the Five Phases, urging that Tang inherit Zhou and Han and that Zhou and Sui be struck from the two honored former dynasties.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚寅，幸華清宮。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the eleventh winter month, he went to Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the eleventh winter month he went to Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 己丑，制自今告獻太清宮及太廟改為朝獻，巡陵為朝拜，告宗廟為奏，天地享祀文改昭告為昭薦，以告者臨下之義故也。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict ordered that henceforth presentation to the Grand Pure Palace and the Imperial Ancestral Temple be changed to court presentation, tomb visitation to court visitation, notification to the ancestral temple to memorial, and the texts of heaven-and-earth sacrifices changed from "proclamation" to "recommendation"—because "proclamation" implies looking down on those below.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict renamed ritual language: offerings at the Grand Pure Palace and Imperial Temple became "court presentation," tomb rites "court visitation," temple notices "memorial," and heaven-and-earth texts "recommendation" instead of "proclamation," since proclamation smacked of condescension.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸楊國忠亭子。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he visited Yang Guozhong's pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he visited Yang Guozhong's pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，立周武王、漢高祖廟於京城，司置官吏。

translations.literal: On xinchou, temples to King Wu of Zhou and Emperor Gaozu of Han were established in the capital, with officials appointed to tend them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou temples to King Wu of Zhou and Han Gaozu were built in the capital, each with its own staff.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，還京。

translations.literal: On yihai of the twelfth month, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the twelfth month he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 天寶十載十載春正月乙酉朔。

translations.literal: On yiyou, new moon of the first spring month of Tianbao 10.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the first spring month of Tianbao 10.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，朝獻太清宮。

translations.literal: On renchen, court presentation was made at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he made court presentation at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: On guisi, court offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he made court offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲午，有事於南郊，合祭天地，禮畢，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the southern suburban rite was performed, with heaven and earth sacrificed together; when the rites were finished, a great amnesty was granted throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he sacrificed to heaven and earth together at the southern suburb; when the rites ended he proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 太廟置內官，供灑掃諸陵廟。

translations.literal: Inner palace attendants were placed at the Imperial Temple to sweep the various mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women were assigned to the Imperial Temple to tend sweeping at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改傳國寶為承天大寶。

translations.literal: On jihai, the transmission seal of state was renamed the Seal of Receiving Heaven's Great Treasure.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the dynastic transmission seal was renamed Seal of Receiving Heaven's Great Treasure.

sentences.zh: 丁未，李林甫領安北副大都護、朔方節度使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Li Linfu took the concurrent posts of vice grand protector of Anbei and Shuofang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Linfu added the posts of Anbei vice grand protector and Shuofang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大風，陜郡運船失火，燒米船二百餘隻，人死者五百計。

translations.literal: On gengxu, great winds; transport boats at Shan commandery caught fire, burning more than two hundred grain ships, and about five hundred people died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu gales set fire to grain transports at Shan commandery, destroying more than two hundred ships and killing some five hundred people.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，分遣嗣吳王祇等十三人祭岳瀆海鎮。

translations.literal: On guichou, thirteen men including successor Prince of Wu Zhi were separately dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, seas, and guardian shrines.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou thirteen princes, including successor Prince of Wu Zhi, were sent out to sacrifice at the sacred mountains, rivers, seas, and guardian deities.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，安祿山兼雲中太守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the second month, An Lushan also became Yunzhong protector and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the second month An Lushan added Yunzhong protector and Hedong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，劍南節度使鮮於仲通將兵六萬討雲南，與雲南王閣羅鳳戰於瀘川，官軍大敗，死於瀘水者不可勝數。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, Jiannan military commissioner Xianyu Zhongtong led sixty thousand troops to attack Yunnan and fought King Piluoge of Yunnan at Luzhou; the government army was greatly defeated, and those drowned in the Lu River were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Xianyu Zhongtong of Jiannan marched sixty thousand men against Yunnan and met King Piluoge at Luzhou; the army was shattered and countless men drowned in the Lu.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，改諸衛幡旗緋色者為赤黃，以符土運。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the fifth month, banners of the guard units that were crimson were changed to red-yellow to accord with the earth phase.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the fifth month guard banners that had been crimson were changed to red-yellow for the earth phase.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙卯，廣陵郡大風，潮水覆船數千艘。

translations.literal: On yimao of the eighth autumn month, great winds at Guangling commandery; tidal waves overturned several thousand ships.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the eighth autumn month gales at Guangling overturned several thousand ships in the tide.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，京城武庫災，燒器械四十七萬事。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the capital armory burned; forty-seven myriad pieces of equipment were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the capital armory burned, destroying forty-seven myriads of weapons and gear.

sentences.zh: 是秋，霖雨積旬，墻屋多壞，西京尤甚。

translations.literal: That autumn, rain fell for successive ten-day periods; many walls and houses collapsed, especially in the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn rain fell for weeks on end; walls and houses collapsed everywhere, worst in the western capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，幸華清宮。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the tenth winter month, he went to Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the tenth winter month he went to Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，幸楊國忠宅。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the eleventh month, he visited Yang Guozhong's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the eleventh month he visited Yang Guozhong's home.

sentences.zh: 丙午，兵部侍郎、兼御史中丞楊國忠兼領劍南節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu, vice minister of war and concurrent censor-in-chief Yang Guozhong also became Jiannan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Yang Guozhong, vice minister of war and censor-in-chief, added Jiannan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 天寶十一載十一載春正月辛亥，還京。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the first spring month of Tianbao 11, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the first spring month of Tianbao 11 he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，禁惡錢，官出好錢以易之。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the second month, debased coin was forbidden; the government issued good coin to exchange for it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the second month debased coin was banned and the treasury issued good cash in exchange.

sentences.zh: 既而商旅不便，訴於國忠，乃止之。

translations.literal: Soon merchants found it inconvenient and appealed to Guozhong; the measure was then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants soon complained to Guozhong of hardship, and the exchange was halted.

sentences.zh: 三月，朔方節度副使、奉信王阿布思與安祿山同討契丹，布思與祿山不協，乃率其部下叛歸漠北。

translations.literal: In the third month, Shuofang deputy military commissioner and Prince of Fengxin Abu Si joined An Lushan in campaigning against the Khitan; Si and Lushan did not agree, and he led his followers in rebellion back to the northern desert.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Abu Si, Shuofang deputy commissioner and Prince of Fengxin, marched with An Lushan against the Khitan; when the two quarreled Si led his men in revolt back to the northern steppe.

sentences.zh: 丙午，制今後每月朔望，宜令薦食於太廟，每室一牙盤，仍五日一開室門灑掃。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict ordered that henceforth on each new and full moon offerings should be set out in the Imperial Temple, one tray per chamber, and every five days the chamber doors should open for sweeping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict required offerings at the Imperial Temple on every new and full moon, one tray per chamber, with doors opened every five days for sweeping.

sentences.zh: 改吏部為文部，兵部為武部，刑部為憲部，其部內諸司有部字者並改，將作大匠、少匠為大、少二監。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel was renamed Ministry of Letters; Ministry of War, Ministry of Martial Affairs; Ministry of Punishments, Ministry of Law; bureaus within whose names bore the character for "ministry" were likewise changed; Director and Vice Director of Palace Construction were renamed Grand and Vice Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel became the Ministry of Letters, War the Ministry of Martial Affairs, Punishments the Ministry of Law; every bureau bearing bu in its title was renamed; the palace construction directors became grand and vice supervisors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，御史大夫兼京兆尹王鉷賜死，坐弟銲與兇人邢縡謀逆故也。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, censor-in-chief and concurrent Jingzhao intendant Wang Hong was granted death, because his younger brother Chuan and the felon Xing Zan plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Wang Hong, censor-in-chief and Jingzhao intendant, was granted death after his brother Chuan and the outlaw Xing Zan were found plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 楊國忠兼京兆尹。

translations.literal: Yang Guozhong also became Jingzhao intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guozhong also took Jingzhao intendant.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，慶王琮薨，贈靖德太子。

translations.literal: On wushen of the fifth month, Prince of Qing Zong died and was posthumously created Jingde Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the fifth month Prince of Qing Zong died and was posthumously created Jingde Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，東京大風，拔樹發屋。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the sixth month, great winds in the eastern capital uprooted trees and tore off roofs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the sixth month gales at Luoyang uprooted trees and stripped roofs.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，幸左藏庫，賜群臣帛有差。

translations.literal: On jichou of the eighth month, he visited the left treasury and granted silk to the host of officials in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the eighth month he visited the left treasury and gave officials graded gifts of silk.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，改諸衛士為武士。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the ninth month, the guard soldiers were renamed warriors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the ninth month the guard regiments were renamed warriors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，幸華清宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the tenth winter month, he went to Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the tenth winter month he went to Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，尚書左僕射兼右相、晉國公李林甫薨於行在所。

translations.literal: On yimao of the eleventh month, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent right chancellor, Duke of Jin Li Linfu, died at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the eleventh month Li Linfu, left vice director and right chancellor, Duke of Jin, died at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，御史大夫兼蜀郡長史楊國忠為右相兼文部尚書。

translations.literal: On gengshen, censor-in-chief and concurrent prefect of Shujun Yang Guozhong became right chancellor and concurrent minister of letters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yang Guozhong, censor-in-chief and prefect of Shujun, became right chancellor and minister of letters.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，楊國忠奏請兩京選人銓日便定留放，無長名。

translations.literal: On jiaxu of the twelfth month, Yang Guozhong memorialized that selections in the two capitals should fix retention and release on the day of evaluation, without the long roster.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the twelfth month Yang Guozhong proposed that capital selections fix appointments the day candidates were evaluated, abolishing the long waiting list.

sentences.zh: 己亥，還京。

translations.literal: On jihai, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 天寶十二載十二載春正月壬子，楊國忠於尚書省注官，注訖，於都堂對左相與諸司長官唱名。

translations.literal: On renzi of the first spring month of Tianbao 12, Yang Guozhong registered appointments at the Ministry of Personnel; when registration was finished, in the main hall he called the roll with the left chancellor and bureau heads.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the first spring month of Tianbao 12 Yang Guozhong registered appointments at Personnel; when the list was done he called names in the main hall with the left chancellor and bureau chiefs.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，選人鄭懟等二十餘人以國忠銓注無滯，設齋於勤政殿下，立碑於尚書省門。

translations.literal: On gengchen of the second month, more than twenty selected men including Zheng Shen and others, because Guozhong's appointments had no backlog, set out a feast below the Qinzheng Hall and erected a stele at the Ministry of Personnel gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen more than twenty appointees led by Zheng Shen, finding Guozhong's registry left no one waiting, feasted below the Qinzheng Hall and raised a stele at the Personnel gate.

sentences.zh: 癸未，追削故右相李林甫在身官爵，男將作監岫、宗黨李復道等五十人皆流貶，國忠誣奏林甫陰結叛胡阿布思故也。

translations.literal: On guimao, the posthumous stripping of the late right chancellor Li Linfu's offices held in life; his son, director of palace construction Xiu, and clansman Fudao and fifty others were all exiled and demoted—Guozhong had falsely memorialized that Linfu had secretly joined the rebel Hu Abu Si.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the court posthumously stripped Li Linfu of every rank he had held; his son Xiu, director of palace construction, kinsman Fudao, and fifty others were exiled—Guozhong had lied that Linfu had colluded with the rebel Abu Si.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙酉，以魏、周、隋依舊為三恪及二王後，復封韓、介、酅等公。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the fifth summer month, Wei, Zhou, and Sui were restored as the three honored former dynasties and two kings after abdication, and the marquises of Han, Jie, and Xi were re-enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the fifth summer month Wei, Zhou, and Sui were restored among the three honored former dynasties and two kings after abdication, and the marquises of Han, Jie, and Xi were re-created.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太廟諸陵署依舊隸太常寺。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the offices of the various mausoleums under the Imperial Temple were restored to the Grand Temple's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the mausoleum offices under the Imperial Temple were returned to the Grand Temple's control.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，天下齊人不得鄉貢，須補國子學生然後貢舉。

translations.literal: On renzi of the seventh month, commoners throughout the empire might not present themselves for provincial recommendation; they had first to enter the Directorate of Education as students before qualifying for the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the seventh month commoners nationwide were barred from direct provincial nomination; they had to enter the Directorate of Education before sitting for the examinations.

sentences.zh: 八月，京城霖雨，米貴，令出太倉米十萬石，減價糶與貧人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, prolonged rain in the capital made rice dear; an order issued one hundred thousand bushels from the great granary to be sold cheaply to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month endless rain drove rice prices up; the court released one hundred thousand bushels from the great granary at reduced price for the poor.

sentences.zh: 仍令中書門下就京兆、大理疏決囚徒。

translations.literal: The Zhongshu Menxia were also ordered to review prisoners at Jingzhao and the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongshu Menxia were likewise ordered to review prisoners held by Jingzhao and the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥朔，隴右節度使、涼國公哥舒翰進封西平郡王，食實封五百戶。

translations.literal: On the new moon of jihai of the ninth month, Longyou military commissioner and Duke of Liang Geshu Han was advanced to Prince of Xiping commandery with a substantive fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the ninth month Geshu Han, commissioner of Longyou and Duke of Liang, was created Prince of Xiping with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，幸華清宮。

translations.literal: On wushen of the tenth winter month, he went to Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the tenth winter month he went to Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 和雇京城丁戶一萬三千人築興慶宮墻，起樓觀。

translations.literal: Thirteen thousand corvée households of the capital were hired to build the walls of Xingqing Palace and raise towers and pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen thousand capital corvée households were hired to wall Xingqing Palace and raise towers and galleries.

sentences.zh: 至十二月，改橫塞城為天德軍。

translations.literal: By the twelfth month, Hengsai Fort was renamed Heavenly Virtue Army.
translations.idiomatic: By the twelfth month Hengsai Fort had been renamed Heavenly Virtue Army.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，行從官憲部尚書張筠等請上尊號為開元天地大寶聖文神武孝德證道皇帝。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Zhang Jun, Minister of Justice among officials in attendance, and others memorialized that the emperor be given the honorific title Emperor of Kaiyuan, Heaven and Earth, Great Treasure, Sagely Culture, Divine Martialism, Filial Virtue, and Manifestation of the Way.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhang Jun and other ministers in attendance asked that the throne take the title Emperor of Kaiyuan, Heaven and Earth, Great Treasure, Sagely Culture, Divine Martialism, Filial Virtue, and Manifestation of the Way.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載十三載春正月丁酉朔，上御華清宮之觀風樓，受朝賀。

translations.literal: In spring of the first month of Tianbao 13, on dingyou the first day of the month, the emperor received court congratulations at the Wind-Watching Tower of Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 13 opened at Huaqing: on dingyou the emperor received New Year homage from the Wind-Watching Tower.

sentences.zh: 己亥，安慶緒獻俘於行在，帝引見於禁中，賞賜巨萬。

translations.literal: On jihai, An Qingxu presented captives at the mobile court; the emperor received him in the inner palace and rewarded him lavishly.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai An Qingxu brought prisoners to the traveling court and was received in the palace with enormous gifts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，加安祿山尚書左僕射，賜實封千戶，奴婢十房，莊、宅各一區；

translations.literal: On yisi, An Lushan was promoted Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, granted a substantive fief of one thousand households, ten households of slaves and maidservants, and one estate and one mansion each;
translations.idiomatic: On yisi An Lushan became Left Vice Director of State Affairs with a thousand-household fief, ten slave households, and a manor and residence apiece;

sentences.zh: 又加閑廄、五坊、宮苑、隴右群牧都使，以武部侍郎吉溫為副。

translations.literal: He was also made concurrent Director of the Imperial Stud, Five Paddocks, Palace Parks, and Longyou Herds; Vice Minister of War Ji Wen served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: and was made master of the stud, parks, and Longyou herds, with Ji Wen of the War Ministry as deputy.

sentences.zh: 丙午，還京。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the court returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the emperor returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，上親朝獻太清宮，上玄元皇帝尊號曰大聖祖高上大廣道金闕玄元天皇大帝。

translations.literal: In the second month on guiyou, the emperor in person offered sacrifice at the Grand Ultimate Palace, raising the honorific of the Supreme Ultimate Emperor of the Mysterious Origin to Great Sagely Ancestor, High Supreme, Great Broad Way, Golden Portal, Mysterious Origin, Heavenly Imperial Great Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he worshipped at the Supreme Ultimate Temple and exalted the divine ancestor as Great Sagely Ancestor, High Supreme, Great Broad Way, Golden Portal, Mysterious Origin Heavenly Emperor.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，親饗太廟，上高祖謚曰神堯大聖大光孝皇帝，太宗謚曰太宗文武大聖大孝皇帝，高宗謚曰高宗天皇大聖大弘孝皇帝，中宗謚曰中宗太和大聖大昭孝皇帝，睿宗謚曰睿宗玄真大聖大興孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he sacrificed in person at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, posthumously ennobling Gaozu as Divine Yao, Great Sagely, Great Radiant Filial Emperor; Taizong as Taizong, Civil and Martial, Great Sagely, Great Filial Emperor; Gaozong as Gaozong, Heavenly Sovereign, Great Sagely, Great Magnificent Filial Emperor; Zhongzong as Zhongzong, Great Harmony, Great Sagely, Great Bright Filial Emperor; and Ruizong as Ruizong, Mysterious Perfection, Great Sagely, Great Flourishing Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he worshipped at the ancestral temple and raised the posthumous titles of the five founders to their grand Sagely-Filial forms.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，御興慶殿受徽號，禮畢，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On yihai he received the honorific title at Xingqing Hall; when the rite was complete he proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he took his new title at Xingqing Hall and amnestied the realm.

sentences.zh: 左降官遭父母憂，放歸。

translations.literal: Officials demoted for mourning were released to go home.
translations.idiomatic: Demoted officials in mourning were sent home.

sentences.zh: 獻陵等五署改為臺，令、丞各升一階。

translations.literal: The five offices of the imperial tombs were changed back to directorates, each commandant and assistant promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: The five tomb offices became directorates again, each chief and deputy rising one step.

sentences.zh: 文武三品已上賜爵一級，四品已下加一階。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of third rank and above received one noble rank; those of fourth rank and below advanced one step.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officers and above gained a noble grade; fourth rank and below rose one step.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Public feasting was granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of public feasting were proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，右相兼文部尚書楊國忠守司空，餘如故。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Right Chancellor and concurrent Minister of Culture Yang Guozhong was made Defender of the State, his other posts unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Yang Guozhong, right chancellor and minister of culture, became Defender of the State.

sentences.zh: 甲申，司空楊國忠受冊，天雨黃土，沾於朝服。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Defender of the State Yang Guozhong received the investiture; yellow earth rained and stained the court robes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Yang Guozhong took the seal while yellow earth rained on the court robes.

sentences.zh: 祿山奏前後討契丹立功將士跳蕩等，請超三資，告身仍望好寫；

translations.literal: Lushan memorialized that the officers and soldiers who had repeatedly campaigned against the Khitan and performed meritorious service, such as Tiao Dang, should be promoted beyond three grades and that their commission documents should be handsomely written;
translations.idiomatic: Lushan asked that veterans of the Khitan campaigns, including Tiao Dang, be promoted more than three grades with fine commission scrolls;

sentences.zh: 於是超授將軍者五百餘人，中郎將者二千餘人。

translations.literal: thereupon more than five hundred men were promoted to general and more than two thousand to vice general.
translations.idiomatic: and more than five hundred became generals and two thousand vice generals.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，太常卿張垍貶盧溪郡司馬，垍兄憲部尚書均貶建安太守。

translations.literal: In the third month on dingyou, Director of the Imperial Music Zhang Yan was demoted to Luzhou Assistant Magistrate, and his brother Zhang Jun, Minister of Justice, was demoted to Jian'an prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhang Yan lost his music directorship for Luzhou and Zhang Jun his justice ministry for Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 丙午，御躍龍殿門張樂宴群臣，賜右相絹一千五百疋，彩羅三百疋，彩綾五百疋；

translations.literal: On bingwu the emperor spread music at the Yue Dragon Hall gate and feasted the ministers, granting the right chancellor one thousand five hundred bolts of silk, three hundred of colored gauze, and five hundred of colored damask;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he feasted ministers at Yue Dragon Hall, giving the right chancellor fifteen hundred bolts of silk and lavish colored silks;

sentences.zh: 左相絹三百疋，彩羅綾各五十疋；

translations.literal: the left chancellor three hundred bolts of silk and fifty each of colored gauze and damask;
translations.idiomatic: the left chancellor three hundred bolts plus fifty each of gauze and damask;

sentences.zh: 餘三品八十疋，四品五品六十疋，六品七品四十疋，極歡而罷。

translations.literal: the rest received eighty bolts at third rank, sixty at fourth and fifth, forty at sixth and seventh—ending in utmost joy.
translations.idiomatic: others by rank down to forty bolts, until the feast broke up in joy.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御勤政樓大酺。

translations.literal: On renxu he held a great feast at the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he held a great banquet at the Hall of Diligent Government.

sentences.zh: 北庭都護程千里生擒阿布思獻於樓下，斬之於硃雀街。

translations.literal: Protector-General of Beiting Cheng Qianli captured Abu Si alive and presented him below the tower; he was beheaded in Vermilion Bird Street.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Qianli of Beiting presented the captive Abu Si below the tower and had him beheaded on Vermilion Bird Street.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，左羽林上將軍封常清權北庭都護、伊西節度使。

translations.literal: On yichou, Senior General of the Left Feathered Forest Feng Changqing was made acting Protector-General of Beiting and Military Commissioner of Yixi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Feng Changqing became acting Beiting protector and Yixi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 萬春公主出降楊朏。

translations.literal: Princess Wanchun married Yang Fei.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Wanchun wed Yang Fei.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，熒惑守心五十餘日。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Mars lingered in the Heart constellation for more than fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Mars stood in the Heart lodge for fifty days.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑朔，日有蝕之，不盡如鉤。

translations.literal: On yichou, the first day of the sixth month, there was a partial eclipse of the sun, the disk not fully covered, like a hook.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the sun was eclipsed to a hook-shaped crescent.

sentences.zh: 侍御史、劍南留後李宓率兵擊雲南蠻於西洱河，糧盡軍旋，馬足陷橋，為閣羅鳳所擒，舉軍皆沒。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor and Acting Military Commissioner of Sword South Li Mi led troops to attack the Yunnan barbarians on the Xi'er River; when provisions were exhausted the army turned back, horses' hooves breaking through a bridge, and Li Mi was captured by Geluofeng; the whole force perished.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mi of Sword South attacked the Yunnan tribes on the Xi'er River, ran out of food on the retreat, lost his army on a broken bridge, and was taken by Geluofeng.

sentences.zh: 廢濟陽郡，以所領五縣隸東平郡。

translations.literal: Jiyang Commandery was abolished; its five counties were attached to Dongping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Jiyang commandery was abolished and its five counties folded into Dongping.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁亥，以久雨，左相、許國公陳希烈為太子太師，罷知政事；

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month on dinghai, because of prolonged rain, Left Chancellor and Duke of Xu Chen Xilie was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and removed from governing affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month endless rain cost Chen Xilie the chancellorship for the grand preceptorship of the heir;

sentences.zh: 文部侍郎韋見素為武部尚書，同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Culture Wei Jiansu was made Minister of War and Grand Councillor of the State Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jiansu became war minister and grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 是秋，霖雨積六十餘日，京城垣屋頹壞殆盡，物價暴貴，人多乏食，令出太倉米一百萬石，開十場賤糶以濟貧民。

translations.literal: That autumn rain lasted more than sixty days; city walls and houses in the capital were nearly all ruined, prices soared, and many lacked food. One million shi of grain were taken from the great storehouse and ten markets opened to sell cheap grain to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Rain for sixty days wrecked the capital; grain was released from the great storehouse and sold cheap at ten markets.

sentences.zh: 東都瀍、洛暴漲，漂沒一十九坊。

translations.literal: The Luo and Chan rivers at the eastern capital rose violently and drowned nineteen wards.
translations.idiomatic: At Luoyang the Luo and Chan floods swallowed nineteen wards.

sentences.zh: 上御勤政樓試四科制舉人，策外加詩賦各一首。

translations.literal: The emperor, at the Hall of Diligent Government, tested candidates of the four examination categories; to the policy questions were added one poem and one rhapsody each.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of Diligent Government he tested the four examination categories, adding a poem and rhapsody to the policy questions.

sentences.zh: 制舉加詩賦，自此始也。

translations.literal: Adding poem and rhapsody to the policy examination began from this time.
translations.idiomatic: From this year the policy examination required poem and rhapsody.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，幸華清宮。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month on renyin, he visited Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he went to Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 貶河東太守韋陟為桂嶺尉，武部侍郎吉溫為澧陽郡長史。

translations.literal: Hedong prefect Wei Zhi was demoted to Guiling district magistrate and Vice Minister of War Ji Wen to chief of Liyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhi of Hedong was demoted to Guiling and Ji Wen to Liyang chief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，開府儀同三司、畢國公竇𤥟薨。

translations.literal: On yisi, Defender of the State Dou Fen of Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Dou Fen, defender of Bi, died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，還京。

translations.literal: On wuwu he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 其載，戶部計今年見管州縣戶口：管郡總三百二十一，縣一千五百三十八，鄉一萬六千八百二十九；

translations.literal: That year the Ministry of Revenue reckoned households and population under current administration: in all three hundred twenty-one prefectures, one thousand five hundred thirty-eight counties, and sixteen thousand eight hundred twenty-nine townships;
translations.idiomatic: That year the revenue ministry counted the realm: three hundred twenty-one prefectures, fifteen hundred thirty-eight counties, sixteen thousand eight hundred twenty-nine townships;

sentences.zh: 戶九百六十一萬九千二百五十四，三百八十八萬六千五百四不課，五百三十萬一千四十四課；

translations.literal: nine million six hundred nineteen thousand two hundred fifty-four households, of which three million eight hundred eighty-six thousand five hundred four owed no tax and five million three hundred one thousand forty-four owed tax;
translations.idiomatic: nine million six hundred nineteen thousand households—three million eight hundred eighty-six thousand tax-exempt and five million three hundred one thousand taxable;

sentences.zh: 口五千二百八十八萬四百八十八，四千五百二十一萬八千四百八十不課，七百六十六萬二千八百課。

translations.literal: fifty-two million eight hundred eighty thousand four hundred eighty-eight persons, of whom forty-two million five hundred twenty-one thousand eight hundred eighty owed no tax and seven million six hundred sixty-two thousand eight hundred owed tax.
translations.idiomatic: fifty-two million eight hundred eighty thousand persons—forty-two million five hundred twenty-one thousand tax-exempt and seven million six hundred sixty-two thousand taxable.

sentences.zh: 天寶十四載十四載春三月丙寅，宴群臣於勤政樓，奏《九部樂》，上賦詩斅柏梁體。

translations.literal: In spring of the third month of Tianbao 14, on bingyin, he feasted the ministers at the Hall of Diligent Government, performing the Nine Department Music; the emperor composed a poem in the Bowang Liang style.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 14, third month: he feasted ministers at the Hall of Diligent Government to the Nine Department Music and wrote a Bowang Liang poem.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣給事中裴士淹等巡撫河南、河北、淮南等道。

translations.literal: On guiwei he dispatched Supervising Secretary Pei Shiyan and others to tour and comfort Henan, Hebei, Huainan, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Pei Shiyan and others were sent to inspect Henan, Hebei, Huainan, and neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，上親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on renchen the emperor personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he reviewed prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，幸華清宮。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month on renchen, he visited Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he went again to Huaqing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，頒《御注老子》並《義疏》於天下。

translations.literal: On jiawu he promulgated the Emperor's Annotated Laozi and its Exegesis throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu his annotated Laozi and commentary went empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午朔，始寧太守羅希奭以停止張博濟決杖而死，吉溫自縊於獄。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the first day of the eleventh month, Shining Peace prefect Luo Xiyi was executed for having Zhang Boji beaten to death while detained; Ji Wen hanged himself in prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Luo Xiyi was executed for beating Zhang Boji to death in custody, and Ji Wen hanged himself in prison.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，范陽節度使安祿山率蕃、漢之兵十餘萬，自幽州南向詣闕，以誅楊國忠為名，先殺太原尹楊光翽於博陵郡。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Military Commissioner of Fanyang An Lushan led more than one hundred thousand barbarian and Chinese troops south toward the capital under the pretext of executing Yang Guozhong, first killing Taiyuan governor Yang Guangxu at Boling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin An Lushan marched south from Youzhou with a hundred thousand men to “execute Yang Guozhong,” killing Yang Guangxu at Boling.

sentences.zh: 壬申，聞於行在所。

translations.literal: On renshen word reached the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the court learned of the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以郭子儀為靈武太守、朔方節度使。

translations.literal: On guiyou Guo Ziyi was made governor of Lingwu and Military Commissioner of Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Guo Ziyi became Lingwu governor and Shuofang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 封常清自安西入奏，至行在。

translations.literal: Feng Changqing came from Anxi to report and reached the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Changqing arrived from Anxi at the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以常清為范陽、平盧節度使、兼御史大夫，令募兵三萬以御逆胡。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Changqing was made Military Commissioner of Fanyang and Pinglu and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, ordered to raise thirty thousand troops to resist the rebel barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Feng Changqing received Fanyang and Pinglu and orders to raise thirty thousand men against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，還京。

translations.literal: On wuyin he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 以羽林大將軍王承業為太原尹，以衛尉卿張介然為陳留太守、河南節度採訪使，以金吾將軍程千里為潞州長史，並令討賊。

translations.literal: Feathered Forest Grand General Wang Chengye was made Taiyuan governor; Court of the Imperial Stud Director Zhang Jieran was made Chenliu prefect and Henan investigative commissioner; Golden Crow General Cheng Qianli was made chief of Lu prefecture—all ordered to attack the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengye became Taiyuan governor, Zhang Jieran Chenliu prefect and Henan commissioner, and Cheng Qianli chief of Lu—all to fight the rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以京兆牧、榮王琬為元帥，命高仙芝副之，於京城召募，號曰天武軍，其眾十萬。

translations.literal: On jiashen Prince Rong Wang Wan was made commander-in-chief, Gao Xianzhi his deputy; troops were recruited in the capital under the name Heavenly Martial Army, numbering one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Prince Rong Wang Wan commanded, with Gao Xianzhi as deputy, and a hundred thousand men were raised as the Heavenly Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，高仙芝等進軍，上御勤政樓送之。

translations.literal: On bingxu Gao Xianzhi and others advanced; the emperor, at the Hall of Diligent Government, saw them off.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Gao Xianzhi marched out while the emperor saw him off from the Hall of Diligent Government.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，祿山於靈昌郡渡河。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the first day of the twelfth month, Lushan crossed the Yellow River at Lingchang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month Lushan crossed the Yellow River at Lingchang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，陷陳留郡，殺張介然。

translations.literal: On xinmao he took Chenliu commandery and killed Zhang Jieran.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he seized Chenliu and killed Zhang Jieran.

sentences.zh: 甲午，陷滎陽郡，殺太守崔無詖。

translations.literal: On jiawu he took Xingyang commandery and killed prefect Cui Wubi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he took Xingyang and killed Cui Wubi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，封常清與賊戰於成皋罌子穀，官軍敗績，常清奔於陜郡。

translations.literal: On bingshen Feng Changqing fought the rebels at Yingzi Valley in Chenggao; the government army was defeated and Changqing fled to Shan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Feng Changqing was beaten at Yingzi Valley and fled to Shan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，祿山陷東京，殺留守李憕、中丞盧奕、判官蔣清。

translations.literal: On dingyou Lushan took the eastern capital and killed acting governor Li Ting, Censor-in-Chief Lu Yi, and aide Jiang Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Lushan took Luoyang and killed Li Ting, Lu Yi, and Jiang Qing.

sentences.zh: 時高仙芝鎮陜郡，棄城西保潼關。

translations.literal: At the time Gao Xianzhi held Shan commandery, abandoned the city, and withdrew west to guard Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xianzhi abandoned Shan and fell back to Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 常山太守顏杲卿與長史袁履謙、賈深等殺賊將李欽湊，執賊將何千年、高邈送京師。

translations.literal: Changshan prefect Yan Gaoqing, with chief clerk Yuan Lvqian, Jia Shen, and others, killed the rebel general Li Qintou and sent the rebel generals He Qiannian and Gao Miao to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Gaoqing of Changshan killed Li Qintou and sent He Qiannian and Gao Miao captive to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔皇太子統兵東討。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict ordered the Crown Prince to command troops eastward to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the crown prince was ordered east with the army.

sentences.zh: 以永王璘為山南節度使，以江陵長史源洧副之；

translations.literal: Prince Yong Wang Lin was made Military Commissioner of Shannan, with Jiangling chief Yuan Wei as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yong Lin became Shannan commissioner with Yuan Wei as deputy;

sentences.zh: 潁王璬為劍南節度使，以蜀郡長史崔圓副之。

translations.literal: Prince Ying Wang Hui was made Military Commissioner of Sword South, with Shu commandery chief Cui Yuan as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ying Hui became Sword South commissioner with Cui Yuan as deputy.

sentences.zh: 二王不出閤。

translations.literal: Neither prince left the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Both princes remained at court without taking up their commands.

sentences.zh: 丙午，斬封常清、高仙芝於潼關，以哥舒翰為太子先鋒兵馬元帥，領河、隴兵募守潼關以拒之。

translations.literal: On bingwu Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi were beheaded at Tong Pass; Ge Shuhan was made Vanguard Commander of the Heir Apparent's Army and led the Hexi and Longyou levies to hold Tong Pass against the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi were executed at Tong Pass and Ge Shuhan took command of the western armies to hold the pass.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，榮王琬薨，贈靖恭太子。

translations.literal: On xinhai Prince Rong Wang Wan died and was posthumously ennobled as the Respectful and Reverent Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Prince Rong Wang Wan died and was given the posthumous title Respectful and Reverent Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 天寶十五載十五載春正月乙卯，御宣政殿受朝。

translations.literal: In spring of the first month of Tianbao 15, on yimao, he received court at the Hall of Propagating Governance.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 15 opened with court at the Hall of Propagating Governance on yimao.

sentences.zh: 其日，祿山僭號於東京。

translations.literal: That day Lushan usurped the title at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day Lushan declared himself emperor at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以李光弼為雲中太守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Li Guangbi was made governor of Yunzhong and Military Commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Guangbi became Yunzhong governor and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賊將蔡希德陷常山郡，執太守顏杲卿、長史袁履謙，殺民吏萬餘，城中流血。

translations.literal: On renxu the rebel general Cai Xide took Changshan commandery, seized prefect Yan Gaoqing and chief clerk Yuan Lvqian, and killed more than ten thousand clerks and people—the city ran with blood.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Cai Xide took Changshan, seized Yan Gaoqing and Yuan Lvqian, and slaughtered ten thousand people.

sentences.zh: 甲子，哥舒翰進位尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jiazi Ge Shuhan was promoted Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Councillor of the State Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Ge Shuhan became left vice director and grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賊將安慶緒犯潼關，哥舒翰擊退之。

translations.literal: On yichou the rebel general An Qingxu attacked Tong Pass; Ge Shuhan drove him back.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou An Qingxu attacked Tong Pass and Ge Shuhan repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，加平原太守顏真卿戶部侍郎，獎守城也。

translations.literal: On yisi Plain prefect Yan Zhenqing was made Vice Minister of Revenue in reward for holding the city.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yan Zhenqing of Pingyuan was made vice minister of revenue for his defense.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，李光弼、郭子儀將兵東出井陘，與賊將史思明戰，大破之，進取郡縣十餘。

translations.literal: In the second month on bingxu Li Guangbi and Guo Ziyi led troops east through Jingxing Pass and fought the rebel general Shi Siming, routing him and recovering more than ten commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Li Guangbi and Guo Ziyi broke Shi Siming at Jingxing and recovered a dozen districts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，誅工部尚書安思順。

translations.literal: On bingchen Minister of Works An Sishun was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen An Sishun was put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午朔，以河東節度使李光弼為御史大夫、范陽節度使。

translations.literal: On renwu, the first day of the third month, Hedong Military Commissioner Li Guangbi was made Censor-in-Chief and Military Commissioner of Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the third-month new moon Li Guangbi became censor-in-chief and Fanyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以平原太守顏真卿為河北採訪使。

translations.literal: On yiyou Plain prefect Yan Zhenqing was made Hebei investigative commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yan Zhenqing became Hebei investigative commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改常山郡為平山郡，房山縣為平山縣，鹿泉縣為獲鹿縣，鹿成縣為束鹿縣。

translations.literal: On jihai Changshan commandery was renamed Pingshan commandery, Fangshan county Pingshan county, Luquan county Huolu county, and Lucheng county Shulu county.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai several placenames in the Hebei theater were renamed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，以贊善大夫來瑱為潁川太守、招討使。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month on bingwu, Instructor Lai Tian was made Yingchuan prefect and Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Lai Tian became Yingchuan prefect and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，南陽太守魯炅與賊將武令珣戰於滍水上，官軍大敗，為賊所虜，進寇我南陽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on wuwu Nanyang prefect Lu Jiong fought the rebel general Wu Linggui on the Zhi River; the government army was utterly defeated, Lu Jiong was captured by the rebels, and they advanced to threaten our Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Lu Jiong was crushed on the Zhi River, captured, and the rebels pressed Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 詔嗣虢王巨自藍田出師救南陽。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Acting Prince of Guo Ju to lead troops from Lantian to relieve Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: The heir of Guo was ordered out from Lantian to save Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，顏真卿破賊將袁知泰於堂邑，北海太守賀蘭進明收信都。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the first day of the sixth month, Yan Zhenqing defeated the rebel general Yuan Zhita at Tangyi; Beihai prefect He Lan Jinming recovered Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Yan Zhenqing beat Yuan Zhita at Tangyi and He Lan Jinming took Xindu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，哥舒翰將兵八萬與賊將崔乾祐戰於靈寶西原，官軍大敗，死者十六七。

translations.literal: On gengyin Ge Shuhan led eighty thousand men to fight the rebel general Cui Qianyou on the western plain of Lingbao; the government army was utterly defeated, six or seven in ten dying.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Ge Shuhan lost eighty thousand men on the Lingbao plain—six or seven in ten dead.

sentences.zh: 其日，李光弼與賊將史思明戰於常山東嘉山，大破之，斬獲數萬計。

translations.literal: That day Li Guangbi fought the rebel general Shi Siming at Jia Mountain east of Changshan and routed him, beheading and capturing tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: That day Li Guangbi shattered Shi Siming east of Changshan and took tens of thousands of heads.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，哥舒翰至潼關，為其帳下火拔歸仁以左右數十騎執之降賊，關門不守，京師大駭，河東、華陰、上洛等郡皆委城而走。

translations.literal: On xinmao Ge Shuhan reached Tong Pass and was seized by his subordinate Huoba Guiren with several dozen horsemen and surrendered to the rebels; the pass was not held, the capital was greatly alarmed, and Hedong, Huayin, Shangluo, and other commanderies all abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Huoba Guiren seized Ge Shuhan at Tong Pass and surrendered; the pass fell, the capital panicked, and the eastern provinces emptied.

sentences.zh: 甲午，將謀幸蜀，乃下詔親征，仗下，從士庶恐駭，奔走於路。

translations.literal: On jiawu, about to flee to Shu, he issued an edict for a personal campaign; when the imperial guard formed up, scholars and commoners were terrified and fled along the roads.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he proclaimed a personal campaign for Shu; the crowd broke in terror along the roads.

sentences.zh: 乙未，凌晨自延秋門出，微雨沾濕，扈從惟宰相楊國忠、韋見素、內侍高力士及太子，親王，妃主、皇孫已下多從之不及。

translations.literal: On yimao, in the early morning he went out through Yanqiu Gate; a light rain dampened them. Only Chancellor Yang Guozhong, Wei Jiansu, the eunuch Gao Lishi, the crown prince, imperial princes, consorts, princesses, and imperial grandsons followed—many could not keep up.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn on yimao he slipped out Yanqiu Gate in drizzle with only Guozhong, Jiansu, Lishi, the heir, and a handful of kin—most of the court left behind.

sentences.zh: 平明渡便橋，國忠欲斷橋。

translations.literal: At daybreak they crossed Bian Bridge; Guozhong wished to cut the bridge.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak they reached Bian Bridge; Guozhong wanted it destroyed.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「後來者何以能濟？

translations.literal: The emperor said, “How can those who come after cross?”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, “What of those who come after?”

sentences.zh: 」命緩之。

translations.literal: He ordered it left intact.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the bridge spared.

sentences.zh: 辰時，至咸陽望賢驛置頓，官吏駭散，無復儲供。

translations.literal: At chen hour they halted at Wangxian post station in Xianyang; officials had scattered and there were no stores prepared.
translations.idiomatic: By midmorning they reached Wangxian post in Xianyang; officials had fled and no food was ready.

sentences.zh: 上憩於宮門之樹下，亭午未進食。

translations.literal: The emperor rested under the trees by the palace gate; noon passed and he had not eaten.
translations.idiomatic: He sat under the palace gate trees past noon without a meal.

sentences.zh: 俄有父老獻鋋，上謂之曰：「如何得飯？

translations.literal: Presently an old man brought gruel; the emperor asked him, “How may we get rice?”
translations.idiomatic: An old man brought gruel; the emperor asked how they might be fed.

sentences.zh: 」於是百姓獻食相繼。

translations.literal: Thereupon the people brought food in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Then the people brought food one after another.

sentences.zh: 俄又尚食持御膳至，上頒給從官而後食。

translations.literal: Soon the imperial kitchen brought the imperial meal; the emperor distributed it to his followers and then ate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the imperial kitchen arrived; he fed his followers before himself.

sentences.zh: 是夕次金城縣，官吏已遁，令魏方進男允招誘，俄得智藏寺僧進芻粟，行從方給。

translations.literal: That evening they halted at Jincheng county; officials had fled. He ordered Wei Fangjin's son Yun to summon them; presently monks of Zhizang Temple brought fodder and grain, and the entourage was finally supplied.
translations.idiomatic: That night at Jincheng the magistrates were gone until Yun of the Wei clan and Zhizang monks brought grain for the starving column.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次馬嵬驛，諸衛頓軍不進。

translations.literal: On bingchen they halted at Mawei post station; the various guards encamped and would not advance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the column stopped at Mawei post and the guards refused to march.

sentences.zh: 龍武大將軍陳玄禮奏曰：「逆胡指闕，以誅國忠為名，然中外群情，不無嫌怨。

translations.literal: Longwu Grand General Chen Xuanli memorialized, saying, “The rebel barbarians point at the palace under the pretext of executing Guozhong, yet within and without none are without suspicion and resentment toward him.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Xuanli of the Longwu Guard said: the rebels march on Chang'an to kill Guozhong, but everyone hates him.

sentences.zh: 今國步艱阻，乘輿震蕩，陛下宜徇群情，為社稷大計，國忠之徒，可置之於法。

translations.literal: Now the state is in peril and the imperial carriage shaken; Your Majesty should follow the feelings of the multitude for the great plan of the altars of soil and grain—Guozhong and his kind may be dealt with by law.
translations.idiomatic: The state was failing and the throne shaken; the emperor should give up Guozhong for the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 」會吐蕃使二十一人遮國忠告訴於驛門，眾呼曰：「楊國忠連蕃人謀逆！

translations.literal: It happened that twenty-one Tibetan envoys blocked Guozhong at the post gate to complain; the crowd shouted, “Yang Guozhong joins the Tibetans in treason!”
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan envoys cornered Guozhong at the gate; the soldiers cried that he plotted with Tibet.

sentences.zh: 」兵士圍驛四合。

translations.literal: Soldiers surrounded the post on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Troops ringed the post.

sentences.zh: 及誅楊國忠、魏方進一族，兵猶未解。

translations.literal: When Yang Guozhong and the Wei Fangjin clan had been executed, the soldiers were still not appeased.
translations.idiomatic: Guozhong and the Wei clan were killed, yet the mutiny did not end.

sentences.zh: 上令高力士詰之，回奏曰：「諸將既誅國忠，以貴妃在宮，人情恐懼。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Gao Lishi to question them; he returned and reported, “The generals have killed Guozhong, but because the consort is in the palace the men still fear.”
translations.idiomatic: Gao Lishi reported that the soldiers feared the consort would bring revenge.

sentences.zh: 」上即命力士賜貴妃自盡。

translations.literal: The emperor at once ordered Lishi to grant the consort death by her own hand.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Lishi to have the consort take her own life.

sentences.zh: 玄禮等見上請罪，命釋之。

translations.literal: Chen Xuanli and the others saw the emperor and begged forgiveness; he ordered them released.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Xuanli begged pardon and was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，將發馬嵬驛，朝臣唯韋見素一人，乃命見素子京兆府司錄諤為御史中丞，充置頓使。

translations.literal: On dingyou, about to depart Mawei post, only Wei Jiansu among the courtiers remained; he therefore made Jiansu's son E, Recorder of the Capital District, Censor-in-Chief and Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou only Wei Jiansu remained at court; his son E became censor and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 議其所向，軍士或言河、隴，或言靈武、太原，或言還京為便。

translations.literal: When they debated where to go, some soldiers said Hexi and Longyou, some Lingwu or Taiyuan, some that returning to the capital would be best.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers argued for Hexi, Lingwu, Taiyuan, or a return to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 韋諤曰：「還京，須有捍賊之備，兵馬未集，恐非萬全，不如且幸扶風，徐圖所向。

translations.literal: Wei E said, “To return to the capital there must be preparations to defend against the rebels; troops and horses are not yet gathered—I fear it is not secure. It is better for now to go to Fufeng and slowly consider our course.”
translations.idiomatic: Wei E urged Fufeng over Chang'an until troops could be gathered.

sentences.zh: 」上詢於眾，咸以為然。

translations.literal: The emperor asked the multitude; all agreed.
translations.idiomatic: He put the question to the column; all assented.

sentences.zh: 及行，百姓遮路乞留皇太子，願戮力破賊，收復京城，因留太子。

translations.literal: When they set out, the people blocked the road begging the crown prince to remain, wishing to exert their strength to destroy the rebels and recover the capital; thus the heir was left behind.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd begged the crown prince to stay and fight for the capital, and he was left behind.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，次扶風縣。

translations.literal: On wuxu they halted at Fufeng county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu they reached Fufeng county.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次扶風郡。

translations.literal: On jihai they halted at Fufeng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai they reached Fufeng commandery.

sentences.zh: 軍士各懷去就，咸出醜言，陳玄禮不能制。

translations.literal: The soldiers each thought of leaving; ugly words were spoken; Chen Xuanli could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: The troops muttered of desertion and Chen Xuanli could not restrain them.

sentences.zh: 會益州貢春彩十萬匹，上悉命置於庭，召諸將諭之曰：「卿等國家功臣，陳力久矣，朕之優獎，常亦不輕。

translations.literal: It happened that a tribute of one hundred thousand bolts of spring silks from Yizhou arrived; the emperor had it all placed in the courtyard and summoned the generals, saying to them, “You are meritorious servants of the state and have long exerted your strength; my generous rewards have never been slight.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou tribute silk filled the courtyard as the emperor told his generals how long they had served and how he had rewarded them.

sentences.zh: 逆胡背恩，事須回避。

translations.literal: The rebel barbarians have betrayed grace; the affair requires withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had betrayed grace and the court had to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 甚知卿等不得別父母妻子，朕亦不及親辭九廟。

translations.literal: I well know you cannot take leave of parents, wives, and children—I too have not been able to bid farewell in person to the nine temples.”
translations.idiomatic: He knew they could not bid their families farewell—he had not even taken leave of the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 」言發涕流。

translations.literal: As he spoke, tears flowed.
translations.idiomatic: He wept as he spoke.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「朕須幸蜀，路險狹，人若多往，恐難供承。

translations.literal: He also said, “I must go to Shu; the road is narrow and dangerous—if too many go, I fear supplies cannot be borne.
translations.idiomatic: He said the road to Shu was too narrow for a crowd.

sentences.zh: 今有此彩，卿等即宜分取，各圖去就。

translations.literal: Now there is this silk; you should at once divide it and each plan whether to stay or go.
translations.idiomatic: He bade them divide the silk and choose stay or go.

sentences.zh: 朕自有子弟中官相隨，便與卿等訣別。

translations.literal: I have my own sons, younger brothers, and palace attendants to follow me, and I will now take leave of you.”
translations.idiomatic: Only his kin and eunuchs would follow; he took leave of the rest.

sentences.zh: 」眾咸俯伏涕泣曰：「死生願從陛下。

translations.literal: All prostrated themselves weeping, saying, “Life and death—we wish to follow Your Majesty.”
translations.idiomatic: All wept that they would follow him to the death.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「去住任卿。

translations.literal: The emperor said, “To go or stay is for you to decide.”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, “Go or stay as you will.”

sentences.zh: 」自此悖亂之言稍息。

translations.literal: From this the seditious talk gradually ceased.
translations.idiomatic: After that the mutinous talk died away.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以司勛郎中、劍南節度留後崔圓為蜀郡長史、劍南節度副大使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Director of Merit Cui Yuan, Acting Military Commissioner of Sword South, was made chief of Shu commandery and Deputy Military Commissioner of Sword South.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Cui Yuan became Shu chief and Sword South deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以潁王璬為劍南節度大使，以監察御史宋若思為御史中丞充置頓使，韋諤充巡閣道使，並令先發。

translations.literal: Prince Ying Wang Hui was made Military Commissioner of Sword South; Investigating Censor Song Ruosi was made Censor-in-Chief and Pacification Commissioner; Wei E was made Commissioner for Inspecting the Post Road—all ordered to go ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ying Hui headed for Shu with Song Ruosi and Wei E sent ahead to prepare the route.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，發扶風郡，是夕，次陳倉。

translations.literal: On xinchou they departed Fufeng commandery; that evening they halted at Chencang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou they left Fufeng and camped at Chencang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，次散關。

translations.literal: On renyin they halted at San Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin they reached San Pass.

sentences.zh: 分部下為六軍，潁王璬先行，壽王瑁等分統六軍，前後左右相次。

translations.literal: The entourage was divided into six armies; Prince Ying Hui went ahead; Princes Shou Ma and others each commanded one of the six armies, front and rear, left and right, in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The column split into six armies under the princes, Ying Hui in the van.
